maxSize.description: Encoded as -F60 in DaemonCommands — 60 minutes between rotations. However, -F controls time-based rotation, not size. Size-based rotation is controlled via -m flag with -z for size limit. Since no size limit is specified in DaemonCommands, and shipped config has no maxSize setting, the *default* is 50000 KB per collectl docs. The shipped config doesn't override this, so default applies.

dav_ca_cert_file.description: Path to a custom CA certificate bundle file (PEM format). If empty, system defaults are used.

dav_cache_dir.description: Local directory for file content caching. Set to '' (empty string) to disable caching entirely (read-only fallback only).

dav_cache_group.description: Group (name or GID) to own cache files and directories.

dav_cache_owner.description: User (name or UID) to own cache files and directories. Must have read/write access to cache_dir.

dav_cache_size_kb.description: Minimum free space (KB) to maintain on the cache directory. When free space drops below this, davfs2 will purge old cached content.

dav_cache_timeout.description: Time in seconds before cached metadata is considered stale. Lower values reduce consistency but improve freshness.

dav_cert_verification.description: Whether to verify WebDAV server certificates over HTTPS. Disable only for testing or with self-signed certs (not recommended in production).

dav_client_cert.description: Path to a client certificate (PEM format). Required only if the server requires mutual TLS authentication.

dav_client_key.description: Path to the private key for the client certificate. Required if client_cert is set.

dav_compression.description: Enable HTTP compression (gzip) for uploads. May improve performance over slow links but can increase CPU usage.

dav_debug.description: Enable debug logging (requires restart to take effect).

dav_dir_mode.description: Octal permissions for newly created directories (e.g., '0755', '0700').

dav_file_mode.description: Octal file permissions for newly created files (e.g., '0644', '0600').

dav_keep_alive.description: Use HTTP/1.1 persistent connections to reduce handshake overhead. Generally safe to enable.

dav_max_conns.description: Maximum number of concurrent connections per WebDAV server. Increase for better throughput on high-latency links.

dav_proxy.description: Proxy server in 'host:port' format (e.g., 'proxy.example.com:3128'). Leave blank to connect directly.

dav_use_locks.description: Enable WebDAV file locking. Disable if the server does not support locking or causes hangs.

dav_use_mmap.description: Use memory-mapped I/O for cached files (improves performance). Disable only if compatibility issues arise.

config_diagnostics.description: Enable diagnostic output; set to 1 to make config errors fatal, 0 to ignore them.

min_proto_dtls.description: Minimum DTLS protocol version (e.g., '1.2') for system_default.

min_proto_tls.description: Minimum TLS protocol version (e.g., '1.2') for system_default.

oid_section.description: Name of section containing custom OIDs (e.g., 'oids').

openssl_conf.description: Name of the initialization section containing module selectors.

rng_properties.description: Property query string for RNG and underlying algorithms.

rng_seed_properties.description: Property query for the randomness source.

rng_type.description: Random bit generator type: CTR-DRBG, HASH-DRBG, or HMAC-DRBG.

davmail_allow_untrusted_certificates.description: Allow connections to Exchange servers using self-signed or untrusted certificates (security risk).

davmail_authentication.description: Authentication method: 'basic' (HTTP Basic Auth) or 'ntlm' (NTLMv2 for Windows domain).

davmail_connectionTimeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds before giving up on establishing a connection to Exchange.

davmail_host.description: Hostname or IP address of your Exchange server.

davmail_imapIdle.description: Enable IMAP IDLE support for real-time push notifications (requires client support).

davmail_imapPort.description: Port for IMAP service (default: 1143). Set to 0 to disable IMAP.

davmail_keyPassword.description: Password for the private key inside the keystore (if different from keystore password).

davmail_keystore.description: Path to Java keystore file containing the server certificate and private key.

davmail_listen.description: Enable or disable the DavMail server. Set to 'false' to stop the server without uninstalling.

davmail_logFile.description: Full path to the log file.

davmail_maxConnections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous connections to Exchange.

davmail_ntlmDomain.description: Windows domain name, required when using NTLM authentication.

davmail_ntlmHost.description: Host (NetBIOS) name of the client workstation, required by some NTLM setups.

davmail_path_exchange.description: URL path to the Exchange web service endpoint (varies by Exchange version).

davmail_popDeletePolicy.description: When to delete messages from Exchange after POP retrieval: 'never', 'onRead', 'onTrash', or 'afterDays:N'.

davmail_popMaxMessages.description: Maximum number of messages per POP session.

davmail_popPort.description: Port for POP3 service (default: 1110). Set to 0 to disable POP3.

davmail_port.description: IMAP default port (used if no specific IMAP port is configured).

davmail_port_exchange.description: Port on which Exchange listens for the selected protocol (usually 443 for HTTPS).

davmail_protocol.description: Protocol to use for connecting to Exchange: 'auto', 'owa', 'ews', or 'exchange2007_sp1_ews'.

davmail_proxy_host.description: Optional HTTP proxy host (e.g., for outbound connections in corporate networks).

davmail_serverId.description: Unique identifier for the DavMail server (used by Outlook to distinguish multiple gateways).

davmail_smtpAllowLocalFrom.description: Allow 'From:' headers to use local-domain addresses (e.g., @localhost).

davmail_smtpAuth.description: Require authentication for sending mail via SMTP (recommended).

davmail_smtpPort.description: Port for SMTP service (default: 1025). Set to 0 to disable SMTP.

davmail_smtpRequireAuth.description: If true, reject unauthenticated SMTP attempts (even if smtpAuth=false).

davmail_smtpStarttls.description: Enable STARTTLS for SMTP (upgrade to TLS after connection).

davmail_smtpUseSSL.description: Enable SSL for SMTP (connect over SSL from the start).

davmail_socketTimeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for socket read operations.

davmail_ssl.description: Enable SSL/TLS encryption for the main port. Requires keystore configuration.

davmail_truststore.description: Path to Java truststore containing trusted CA certificates (for validating Exchange server certificate).

davmail_username.description: Exchange username (if not using per-user credentials in mailboxes section).

davmail_webPort.description: Port for the web UI (used only if web_enabled=true).

davmail_web_enabled.description: Enable built-in web UI for diagnostics and status (port 8080 by default).

nvdimm_uuid.description: UUID of the NVDIMM device to reconfigure

subsection_name.description: Unique identifier for the reconfigure-device subsection; must be unique across all config files

sysconfdir.description: Base directory for system configuration files

beacon_addr.description: ASM beacon group address (with optional port, e.g., '224.0.1.1:10001' or 'ff02::1:10001').

bootstrap_addr.description: Bootstrap peer address to use when ASM is broken but SSM works.

dump_file.description: Path to periodic dump file in XML format.

interface.description: Network interface to use for multicast (e.g., 'eth0').

ipv4_only.description: Force IPv4 usage (overrides default IPv6 preference).

local_addr.description: Local source address for multicast packets (e.g., '192.0.2.1').

name.description: The name identifying this beacon instance (defaults to hostname if omitted).

pidfile.description: Path to PID file for daemonized instance.

program_to_launch.description: Program to run after each dump. First argument will be dump filename.

ssm_group.description: SSM group address (with optional port, e.g., '232.1.2.3:10001').

ssm_send.description: Enable SSM data sending in addition to ASM (i.e., -O).

verbose.description: Verbosity level; value determines number of -v flags.

auth_method.description: Authentication method for clients (none = open, password = basic auth, cert = mutual TLS).

cache_size_mb.description: Size of the in-memory query result cache in megabytes.

db_path.description: Absolute path to the directory where database files (indices, data, cache) are stored.

enable_compression.description: Whether to compress stored records to save disk space and I/O (may increase CPU usage).

idle_timeout_sec.description: Maximum idle time (in seconds) before a client connection is closed.

listen_address.description: IP address the service listens on (e.g., 127.0.0.1 for localhost only, or 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces).

listen_port.description: TCP port number for client connections.

log_file.description: Path to the log file. Use 'stdout' to log directly to the console.

log_level.description: Verbosity level for logging (debug, info, warn, error).

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent client connections allowed.

password_file.description: Path to the file containing usernames and hashed passwords (used when auth_method = password).

query_timeout_sec.description: Maximum allowed time (in seconds) for a single query before it is aborted.

tls_cert.description: Path to the server TLS certificate (PEM format), required when auth_method = cert.

tls_key.description: Path to the server TLS private key (PEM format), required when auth_method = cert.

worker_threads.description: Number of worker threads for parallel query processing. Set to match available CPU cores.

allow_anonymous.description: If true, allow ANONYMOUS auth mechanism (insecure unless explicitly designed)

fork.description: If true, fork into background (equivalent to <fork/>)

include_dir_ignore_missing.description: If true, missing files in include_dir are ignored

keep_umask.description: If true, retain original umask after forking

policies[].at_console.description: If true, applies to console sessions; if false, to non-console

run_as_user.description: Username or UID to run daemon as (e.g., messagebus, root, _example)

selinux_associations[].context.description: SELinux target context for acquiring the name (e.g., 'foo_t')

selinux_enabled.description: If true, enable SELinux configuration (must have <selinux> block)

servicehelper.description: SetUID helper to launch system services (e.g., /usr/lib/dbus-1.0/dbus-daemon-launch-helper)

standard_session_servicedirs.description: If true, use standard session service directories (session bus only)

standard_system_servicedirs.description: If true, use standard system service directories (system bus only)

syslog.description: If true, log to syslog (command-line overrides)

chroot.description: If true, chroot into LibDir before running services — only use if security hardening is required and services support it.

dbus_bus.description: D-Bus bus type: 'system' or 'session'. Set by the package and rarely changed.

dbus_name.description: D-Bus service name used by oddjobd.

dbus_path.description: D-Bus object path implemented by oddjobd.

debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging to the system log (syslog/journald). Turn on only for troubleshooting.

group.description: System group under which the daemon runs.

lib_dir.description: Path to the directory containing oddjob helper programs. Usually set by the package installer.

max_threads.description: Maximum number of worker threads. Set to 0 for no limit (but system resources still apply).

pid_file.description: Full path to the file where the daemon writes its process ID.

run_dir.description: Directory for transient runtime files used by the daemon and its helpers.

session_tracking.description: Enable PAM session tracking. Required for services that need to interact with user sessions (e.g., mounting user home directories).

user.description: System user under which the oddjobd daemon process runs. Should have minimal privileges.

leases.backend.description: Lease storage backend. 'file' persists leases across restarts; 'memory' resets on reload.

leases.path.description: Path to the lease file when using the 'file' backend. Ignored for 'memory' backend.

server.address.description: Network address and port for the DHCP server to listen on (e.g., '192.168.1.1:67' or ':67' for all interfaces).

server.ipv6_enabled.description: Enable or disable IPv6 support (DHCPv6) in addition to IPv4 (DHCPv4).

server.log_level.description: Verbosity of server logging. Options: debug, info, warn, error.

block_size.description: Uniform block size in bytes for both IFILE and OFILE (conflicts with ibs/obs). For pt devices, must match device logical block size.

blocks_per_transfer.description: Number of input blocks per transfer buffer (BPT). Controls copy buffer size: IBS * BPT. Must satisfy ((IBS * BPT) % OBS == 0).

cdb_size.description: SCSI CDB size in bytes (0=auto, or 6,10,12,16,32). 0 uses auto-selection logic.

cmd_duration_limit.description: Command duration limit (CDL) value (0-7). 0 means no limit. Only effective with cdbsz >= 16.

continue_on_error.description: Continue copying despite input errors (coe=1). Not effective for output errors on regular files.

copy_blocks.description: Number of blocks to copy. -1 means 'all available'.

dry_run.description: Enable dry-run mode (--dry-run). Parses and validates arguments but skips actual I/O.

input_block_size.description: Input block size in bytes (conflicts with bs). Default: same as bs.

input_file.description: Input file/device path (required). Use '-' for stdin. Must be specified.

output_block_size.description: Output block size in bytes (conflicts with bs). Default: same as bs.

output_file.description: Output file/device path (optional). Defaults to /dev/null. Use '-' for stdout.

progress_report.description: Enable progress reporting (status=progress). Prints throughput/ETA periodically to stderr.

protect_read.description: RDPROTECT field for READ commands (0-7). Requires IFILE to be a pt device if >0.

protect_write.description: WRPROTECT field for WRITE commands (0-7). Requires OFILE to be a pt device if >0.

pt_access.description: Use SCSI pass-through (pt) access. Required for raw SCSI commands on devices that support both pt and standard I/O.

retries.description: Number of retries for transient SCSI errors on pt devices.

seek_blocks.description: Number of output blocks to seek before writing.

skip_blocks.description: Number of input blocks to skip before copying.

sparse_writes.description: Skip writing blocks that are entirely zero (sparse writes).

use_odx.description: Enable offloaded copy using ODX (XCOPY(LID4) subset).

use_xcopy.description: Enable offloaded copy using XCOPY(LID1) commands.

verbose_level.description: Verbose/diagnostic level (0-5). Higher values increase stderr output.

verify_mode.description: Enable verify mode (--verify). Compares IFILE and OFILE contents without copying.

cache_dns.description: Enable DNS caching to reduce lookups

foreground.description: Run in foreground (true) or as a background daemon (false)

host.description: The hostname or domain to update (e.g., example.dyndns.org or 'all.dnsomatic.com' for all registered IPs)

interface.description: Local IP address the web interface should bind to (e.g., 127.0.0.1 for localhost only)

interval.description: Update interval in seconds (only used in daemon mode)

log_file.description: Path to log file (set to empty string to disable file logging)

log_level.description: Minimum log level: debug, info, warning, error, or critical

password.description: Password or API token for the DNS service (required for most plugins)

plugin_option.description: Additional plugin-specific option string (e.g., 'hostname' for some plugins)

port.description: Port number for the internal web interface (use 0 to disable)

ssl_key.description: Path to TLS private key file

use_tls.description: Enable TLS/SSL for the web interface (requires valid cert/key)

user.description: Username for the DNS service (often email address or API username)

execute_command.description: Command to pass to the terminal application to load an external command within the terminal. Most terminal emulators support '-e' for this command.

terminal.description: Terminal application used for viewers that require a terminal.

artifacts_dir.description: Path to the directory where collected test artifacts (logs, reports, binaries) are stored.

compress_artifacts.description: Whether to compress artifacts (gzip) before saving them to disk to reduce storage usage.

health_endpoint.description: HTTP path for the health check endpoint (e.g., used by Kubernetes liveness/readiness probes).

listen_address.description: IP address the collector binds to. Use 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces, or a specific IP to restrict.

log_file.description: Path to the log file. Use '-' for standard error.

log_level.description: Verbosity of application logging.

max_artifact_size_mb.description: Maximum allowed size (in MiB) for a single artifact. Larger artifacts are rejected.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous open connections allowed.

metrics_enabled.description: Whether to expose Prometheus-compatible metrics endpoint.

metrics_port.description: Port on which the metrics endpoint is served (if enabled).

port.description: TCP port on which the collector service accepts incoming HTTP requests.

workers.description: Number of worker processes to handle incoming requests. Set higher for high throughput.

config_filename.description: Path to the config database file.

passwords_filename.description: Path to the passwords database file.

templates_filename.description: Path to the templates database file.

force.description: Force non-interactive mode, answering 'No' to all questions (same as -f).

guess_depends.description: Comma-separated list of suffixes to treat as dependencies of the base package name.

info_cmd.description: Command used to display package information.

keep_sections.description: Comma-separated list of package sections to always keep.

keeper_file.description: Path to the file storing the list of kept/orphaned packages.

max_priority.description: Highest priority level to ask questions about. Possible values: required, important, standard, optional, extra, or ANY.

negative_keepers.description: Whether to respect negative entries (explicit removals) in the keeper file.

nokeep_sections.description: Comma-separated list of package sections to never keep.

remove_cmd.description: Command used to remove packages (with purge).

use_essential.description: Consider packages marked 'Essential: yes' as keepers.

use_hold.description: Consider packages marked with 'hold' status as keepers.

use_tasks.description: Treat tasksel tasks as regular packages (prefixed 'task-').

verbose.description: Enable verbose output (same as -v on command line).

apt.use_debian_edu_repo.description: Include the official Debian-Edu APT repository (recommended for full feature set).

debian_edu.enabled.description: Enable or disable all Debian-Edu-specific customizations.

debian_edu.hostname_prefix.description: Prefix for automatically generated hostnames (e.g., 'edu', 'school'). Leave empty to disable.

enabled.description: Enable the content filter service.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity: 'debug', 'info', 'warn', or 'error'.

mode.description: Filtering mode: 'block' (default), 'monitor', or 'off'. In 'monitor' mode, violations are logged but not blocked.

admin_server.description: Hostname or IP address of the Kerberos admin server (for password changes, etc.).

enabled.description: Enable the Kerberos 5 connector plugin.

kdc.description: Hostname or IP address of the KDC server for the realm.

keytab.description: Path to keytab file for service principal authentication. Leave blank if not used.

krb5_conf.description: Path to the system Kerberos configuration file.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level (debug, info, warning, error).

max_ttl.description: Maximum renewable ticket lifetime in seconds.

realm.description: Kerberos realm used for authentication (e.g., the institution's realm).

service_principal.description: Kerberos service principal (used with keytab if provided).

group_base.description: Optional custom base DN for group searches. Defaults to `ldap_base_dn` if empty.

ldap_base_dn.description: Base DN for LDAP searches (e.g., the root of your directory tree).

ldap_bind_dn.description: Distinguished Name (DN) used to bind to the LDAP directory for read-only access.

ldap_bind_password.description: Password for the bind DN. Keep secret; consider using a secure credential store in production.

ldap_ca_cert_path.description: Path to CA certificate file for verifying LDAP server identity (e.g., `/etc/ssl/certs/ldap-ca.crt`). Optional; leave empty to skip verification.

ldap_port.description: Port number for the LDAP server (typically 389 for non-SSL, 636 for LDAPS).

ldap_server.description: Hostname or IP address of the LDAP server to connect to.

ldap_use_ssl.description: Whether to use SSL/TLS for the LDAP connection (recommended for production).

sync_enabled.description: Enable automatic synchronization of users and groups from LDAP.

user_base.description: Optional custom base DN for user searches. Defaults to `ldap_base_dn` if empty.

enabled.description: Enable or disable the mDNS reflector service.

log_file.description: Path to a dedicated log file, or leave empty / set to 'syslog' to use the system logger.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level. Choose from: debug, info, notice, warning, error, critical.

max_queries_per_second.description: Maximum number of mDNS queries per second to reflect. Helps prevent reflection storms.

max_reflected_entries.description: Maximum number of simultaneous mDNS entries (hosts, services) to track and reflect. Prevents memory exhaustion on large networks.

record_ttl.description: Time-to-live (in seconds) for reflected mDNS records. Controls how long reflected entries remain valid.

debug.description: Enable maximum debug output (–debug / -d).

gnupg_program.description: The name (or pathname) of the GnuPG program to use (DEBSIG_GNUPG_PROGRAM).

list_policies.description: List policies that passed Selection phase, without verification (–list-policies).

quiet.description: Suppress all output except fatal errors (–quiet / -q).

root_dir.description: Use a different root directory when looking up for policies and OpenPGP keyrings.

use_policy.description: Policy file name (without path) to use for verification. Overrides automatic selection.

verbose.description: Increase output verbosity to show execution steps (–verbose / -v).

AllowUnsafePermissions.description: If true, allow unsafe options (e.g., host /dev, /proc) in debspawn run.

BootstrapTool.description: Bootstrap tool (must be compatible with debootstrap interface).

CachePackages.description: If false, debspawn will not manage its own APT package cache.

DefaultBootstrapVariant.description: Default variant used for bootstrapping with debootstrap. Set to 'none' for no variant.

InjectedPkgsDir.description: Directory for pre-injected package files (root or per-image subdirs).

ResultsDir.description: Default output directory for build artifacts.

debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging (not recommended in production)

state_dir.description: Directory to store persistent state (jobs, workers, etc.)

tmp_dir.description: Directory for temporary files (e.g., uploaded artifacts)

signing_key_id.description: Human-readable identifier for the signing key. If empty, the key's fingerprint will be used automatically.

signing_key_passphrase.description: Passphrase to decrypt the private key (if encrypted). Leave empty for unencrypted keys.

signing_key_path.description: Absolute path to the private signing key file (e.g., RSA/EC private key in PEM format).

signing_signature_ttl.description: Time-to-live for generated signatures in seconds (e.g., 31536000 = 1 year). After this, signatures expire.

verify_max_signature_age.description: Maximum age (in seconds) for accepted signatures. Older signatures are rejected (e.g., 2592000 = 30 days).

verify_require_trusted_key.description: If true, verification fails if the signing key is not explicitly trusted. If false, falls back to allowing keys in the trusted keys path if no match is found.

verify_trusted_keys_path.description: Path to a directory containing trusted public keys (PEM format), or a file containing concatenated trusted keys.

hour_end.description: Ending hour of the hourly range

hour_start.description: Starting hour of the hourly range

path.description: PATH environment variable for cron jobs

shell.description: Shell used to execute cron commands

modules.default: battery ac processor button fan thermal video
modules.description: Space-separated list of kernel modules to load before starting acpid; use "all" to load all acpi drivers, or leave empty/commented to load none

options.description: Additional command-line options to pass to acpid (as a string to be appended to the acpid command)

defuser.description: User account under which the ample service runs

LOG.description: Directory where log files are stored

POWERON.description: Default power-on time in 24-hour HH:MM format

ionice_setting.description: IONICE setting for the BackupPC daemon (e.g., 'idle', 'best-effort:6'). Empty string disables IONICE.

nice_value.description: Nice value for the BackupPC daemon (e.g., 0, 10, 19). Higher means lower priority.

data_dir.description: Directory to persist jobs to disk (enables durability). Empty string disables persistence.

listen_host.description: IP address or hostname for the primary listen socket (e.g., '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces).

bluetooth_id.description: Bluetooth device address (MAC) to monitor; multiple devices may be space-separated

arbitrator-user.description: System user for the boothd process on the arbitrator.

attr-prereq.description: Expression to test site GEO attributes (format: <grant_type> <name> <op> <value>).

authfile.description: File containing the shared secret authentication key.

before-acquire-handler.description: Path to a script or directory containing pre-acquisition verification programs.

mode.description: Ticket control mode; automatic uses Raft algorithm, manual is admin-controlled.

renewal-freq.description: Ticket renewal frequency period in seconds.

site-group.description: System group for the boothd process on cluster sites.

site-user.description: System user for the boothd process on cluster sites.

ticket.description: Ticket names to be registered and managed.

transport.description: Transport protocol for Raft exchanges. Currently only UDP is supported.

weights.description: Comma-separated integers defining Raft member weights; defaults to 0 for all.

DAEMON_OPTS.description: Additional command-line options passed to the brightd daemon

START_BRIGHTD.description: Whether brightd should be started on login (must be 'true' to enable)

BTRFS_ALLOW_CONCURRENCY.description: If true, allow concurrent btrfs maintenance jobs (otherwise they run in FIFO order).

BTRFS_BALANCE_DUSAGE.description: Usage percent range for balancing data block groups (space-separated min max).

BTRFS_BALANCE_MOUNTPOINTS.description: Colon-separated list of mountpoints/filesystems to balance periodically. 'auto' means all mounted btrfs filesystems.

BTRFS_BALANCE_MUSAGE.description: Usage percent for balancing metadata block groups (and mixed blockgroups).

BTRFS_BALANCE_PERIOD.description: Frequency of periodic balance. Valid values: none, daily, weekly, monthly. Also supports systemd.time(7) calendar events.

BTRFS_DEFRAG_MIN_SIZE.description: Minimal file size to consider for defragmentation.

BTRFS_DEFRAG_PATHS.description: Colon-separated list of paths to defragment periodically. Empty means none.

BTRFS_DEFRAG_PERIOD.description: Frequency of periodic defragmentation. Valid values: none, daily, weekly, monthly. Also supports systemd.time(7) calendar events.

BTRFS_LOG_OUTPUT.description: Output target for messages. Valid values: none, stdout, journal, syslog.

BTRFS_SCRUB_MOUNTPOINTS.description: Colon-separated list of mountpoints/filesystems to scrub periodically. 'auto' means all mounted btrfs filesystems.

BTRFS_SCRUB_PERIOD.description: Frequency of periodic scrub. Valid values: none, weekly, monthly. Also supports systemd.time(7) calendar events.

BTRFS_SCRUB_PRIORITY.description: I/O priority for scrub. Valid values: idle, normal.

BTRFS_SCRUB_READ_ONLY.description: If true, perform read-only scrub without attempting repairs.

BTRFS_TRIM_MOUNTPOINTS.description: Colon-separated list of mountpoints/filesystems to trim periodically. 'auto' means all mounted btrfs filesystems.

BTRFS_TRIM_PERIOD.description: Frequency of periodic trim. Valid values: none, daily, weekly, monthly. Also supports systemd.time(7) calendar events.

proactive.description: Whether to proactively load files for frequently-used processes *before* they are opened (improves responsiveness, but may increase disk usage).

profile_dir.description: Directory where preload stores readahead profiles for known files and applications.

readahead_pages.description: Maximum number of pages to read ahead per I/O request. Set to 0 to use the kernel's default value.

scan_interval.description: How often (in seconds) the daemon scans the system for new processes and updates its database.

enforce_src.description: If true, only accept ICMP packets from IPs listed in allowed_src_nets.

listen_interface.description: Network interface to listen on. Use 'auto' to let ptunnel auto-detect.

log_file.description: Path to log file. Leave empty to log only to stdout/stderr.

max_idle_time.description: Maximum inactivity (in seconds) before a tunnel is forcibly closed.

max_tunnels.description: Maximum number of concurrent tunnels (TCP connections) allowed.

password.description: Password for securing the tunnel. Must be identical on both client and server.

ping_delay.description: Delay (in milliseconds) between consecutive ping packets. Lower = more aggressive, higher = more reliable through firewalls.

ping_dest_port.description: ICMP destination port used in the ICMP tunnel (must match between client and server). 0 = echo request.

ping_size.description: Size (in bytes) of ICMP payload. Larger sizes may improve throughput but increase fragmentation.

ping_ttl.description: Time-to-live (TTL) value for outgoing ICMP packets. 0 = use system default.

remote_dst.description: Target remote IP address for the ICMP tunnel (required on the receiving end).

run_daemon.description: Set to "true" to enable the ptunnel daemon (must be set to 'true' to start the service).

tunnel_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) after which an idle tunnel is closed.

verbose.description: Enable verbose logging? If true, logs at normal level. Use 0 or 1 explicitly for fine control.

db_host.description: Hostname or IP address of the PostgreSQL server.

db_name.description: Name of the PostgreSQL database to use.

db_password.description: Password for the database user. Leave empty if using peer auth or SSL certs.

db_ssl.description: Whether to use SSL when connecting to PostgreSQL.

db_ssl_ca_cert.description: Path to CA certificate used to verify the PostgreSQL server.

db_ssl_key.description: Path to client private key for PostgreSQL SSL authentication.

db_type.description: Database backend. PuppetDB supports only PostgreSQL.

db_user.description: Database user account PuppetDB will connect as.

ha_enabled.description: Enable high-availability mode (requires external database HA & load balancer).

http_host.description: Interface to bind the HTTP endpoint to. Use '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces (not recommended in production without TLS).

https_host.description: Interface to bind the HTTPS endpoint to.

https_ssl_ca_cert.description: Path to CA cert used to verify client certificates (optional).

https_ssl_key.description: Path to private key for HTTPS. Must be world-readable if owned by root.

java_args.description: Java arguments passed to PuppetDB JVM (e.g., memory limits, GC options, JMX settings).

log_level.description: Verbosity of PuppetDB logging. Valid values: debug, info, warn, error, fatal.

max_connection_pool_size.description: Maximum number of database connections in the pool.

node_purge_ttl.description: Time after which inactive nodes are purged from the database.

query_max_queue_size.description: Maximum number of queued queries before rejecting.

query_workers.description: Number of threads used to process queries concurrently.

request_timeout.description: Maximum time to wait for a request (e.g., '30s', '5m').

enabled.description: Enable or disable the rdnssd daemon at boot.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity: 0=quiet, 1=error, 2=warn, 3=info (default), 4=debug, up to 7=verbose debug.

max_ns.description: Maximum number of DNS servers to add per interface from Router Advertisement data. Too many servers may exceed resolver limits.

merge_hook_path.description: Path to an optional script to be called whenever the configuration file written by rdnssd is updated. Comment out to disable.

pid_file_path.description: Path to the PID file used by rdnssd to store its process ID.

resolv_conf_path.description: Path to the resolver configuration file that rdnssd will update with discovered DNS servers.

systemd_socket_activation.description: Enable systemd socket activation for rdnssd (advanced; requires compatible systemd and rdnssd build).

user.description: System user account to drop privileges to after startup for security.

rsync_enable.description: Whether to enable rsync daemon mode via init.d. Allowed values: "true", "false", "inetd".

rsync_nice.description: Nice level (0–19) for rsync daemon; empty string leaves it unset.

rsync_opts.description: Extra command-line options for rsync daemon (e.g., '--address=127.0.0.1 --port=873').

sbd_debug_log.description: Unused in this template (no debug logging option in this config file).

sbd_delay_start.description: Seconds to delay SBD startup (SBD_DELAY_START); can be 'no', 'yes', or an integer (seconds).

sbd_device.description: Primary shared disk device used for SBD fencing (e.g., a persistent reservation-capable SCSI-3 device).

sbd_enabled.description: Unused in this template (SBD is always active if configured); SBD_PACEMAKER=yes controls pacemaker integration.

sbd_pidfile.description: Unused in this template (SBD uses hardcoded PID file path).

sbd_retries.description: Unused in this template (SBD does not expose a direct retries parameter in its default config).

sbd_timeout_start.description: Seconds to wait for SBD to stop gracefully before forcing a reboot (not directly configurable in this config file; handled by systemd TimeoutStartSec).

sbd_timeout_stop.description: Seconds to wait for SBD to stop during shutdown before forcing reboot (not directly configurable in this config file; handled by systemd TimeoutStopSec).

sbd_watchdog_ticks.description: Number of seconds the watchdog will wait before panicking the node if no-one tickles it (SBD_WATCHDOG_TIMEOUT).

group.description: System group under which shadowsocks-libev runs

maxfd.description: Maximum number of open file descriptors (ulimit -n); increase for high-concurrency deployments

auto_whitelist_path.description: Path to auto-whitelist database file (set to null to disable auto-whitelisting).

bayes_backend.description: Bayes storage backend (e.g., 'DB_File', 'SQLite', 'MySQL', 'PgSQL'). Set to null to disable Bayes.

bind_address.description: IP address to bind the spamd daemon to (e.g., '127.0.0.1' for localhost only, or '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces).

blacklist_file.description: Path to a file containing blacklisted sender addresses (one per line). Optional.

local_rules_dir.description: Directory containing local rule files (*.cf) — overrides default local rules directory.

log_packets.description: If true, logs raw message headers/lines to syslog (verbose; for debugging only).

pidfile.description: Path to the PID file for spamd.

port.description: TCP port on which spamd listens for client connections.

rules_dir.description: Base directory for system-wide SpamAssassin rules (override if rules installed elsewhere).

syslog_facility.description: Syslog facility to use when logging to syslog (e.g., 'mail', 'daemon', 'local0').

timeout_local.description: Timeout (seconds) for local processing (e.g., rule evaluation).

http.description: Optional HTTP interface (e.g., ':8080') for direct testing or frontend without reverse proxy

inherited_config.description: Path to the inherited default configuration file

log_level.description: Log verbosity: 0=error, 1=warn, 2=info, 3=debug

api_version.description: Optional OpenStack API version override (e.g., '3'). Usually auto-detected.

cafile.description: Path to a custom CA bundle PEM file for SSL verification

certfile.description: Path to a client certificate PEM file for mutual TLS (optional)

insecure.description: Disable SSL certificate verification (use only in test environments)

password.description: Password for the OpenStack user. Keep secret!

project_name.description: OpenStack project (tenant) name containing the target VMs to fence

region.description: Optional OpenStack region (e.g., 'regionOne'). If omitted, the default region is used.

username.description: OpenStack username with appropriate permissions (e.g., for fencing)

ovh_application_key.description: OVH API Application Key (required for authentication)

ovh_application_secret.description: OVH API Application Secret (required for authentication)

ovh_consumer_key.description: OVH API Consumer Key (required for authentication); generated after authorization

ovh_ipmi_interface.description: IPMI interface type (e.g., 'lan', 'lanplus'); affects protocol security

ovh_retries.description: Number of times to retry failed fence operations

ovh_retry_max_delay.description: Maximum delay (in seconds) between retry attempts (exponential backoff is used)

ovh_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for API requests to OVH

ovh_use_internal_ip.description: Use the node's internal IP instead of public IP for fencing (if available)

api_path.description: API path suffix — usually `/api` for RHEV-M 3.x/4.x.

hostname.description: Hostname or IP address of the RHEV Manager (RHEV-M) API endpoint.

login.description: Username for RHEV-M API authentication (e.g., admin@internal or admin@domain.com).

secure.description: Whether to use HTTPS (secure) or HTTP (insecure). Should always be enabled in production.

ssl_verify.description: Whether to validate the RHEV-M server’s SSL certificate (disable only for self-signed in controlled environments).

sbd_debug_log.description: Unused in this template (no debug logging option in this config file).

sbd_delay_start.description: Seconds to delay SBD startup (SBD_DELAY_START); can be 'no', 'yes', or an integer (seconds).

sbd_device.description: Primary shared disk device used for SBD fencing (e.g., a persistent reservation-capable SCSI-3 device).

sbd_enabled.description: Unused in this template (SBD is always active if configured); SBD_PACEMAKER=yes controls pacemaker integration.

sbd_pidfile.description: Unused in this template (SBD uses hardcoded PID file path).

sbd_retries.description: Unused in this template (SBD does not expose a direct retries parameter in its default config).

sbd_timeout_start.description: Seconds to wait for SBD to stop gracefully before forcing a reboot (not directly configurable in this config file; handled by systemd TimeoutStartSec).

sbd_timeout_stop.description: Seconds to wait for SBD to stop during shutdown before forcing reboot (not directly configurable in this config file; handled by systemd TimeoutStopSec).

sbd_watchdog_ticks.description: Number of seconds the watchdog will wait before panicking the node if no-one tickles it (SBD_WATCHDOG_TIMEOUT).

vbox_cacert.description: Absolute path to a custom CA certificate bundle (PEM format) for HTTPS validation. Overrides system trust store if provided.

vbox_host.description: Hostname or IP address where the VirtualBox host service (VBoxHeadless/VBoxWebSrv) runs.

vbox_insecure.description: If true (set to '1'), skip SSL certificate validation for HTTPS connections (e.g., for self-signed certs). Not recommended for production.

vbox_password.description: Password for the above username. Recommended to use a secure credential store (e.g., via agent or environment) — do not store plaintext if avoidable.

vbox_port.description: TCP port used by the VirtualBox web service (default: 18083).

vbox_power_wait.description: Seconds to wait after a power-off command before sending a power-on — prevents race conditions with rapid fencing.

vbox_protocol.description: Communication protocol: 'http' or 'https'. Use 'https' in production for security.

vbox_timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for a fence command (e.g., power-off/on) to complete.

vbox_username.description: Username for authenticating with the VirtualBox web service (must have VM control permissions).

vbox_vmname.description: Name of the VirtualBox VM to fence. Must exactly match the VM name as shown by `VBoxManage list vms`.

ipmi_addr.description: Hostname or IP address of the remote IPMI BMC interface (e.g., '192.168.1.10'). Required.

ipmi_cipher_suite.description: Optional numeric cipher suite ID for RMCP+ (e.g., '3' for AES-CBC-128). Leave blank to use default.

ipmi_interface_type.description: IPMI interface type: 'lan' (unencrypted RMCP), 'lanplus' (encrypted RMCP+), or 'serial'. Use 'lanplus' for security.

ipmi_pass.description: Password for the IPMI user. DEPRECATED — prefer using ipmi_passfile for security. Leave empty if using passfile.

ipmi_privilege_level.description: IPMI privilege level required to perform fencing operations (e.g., 'OPERATOR', 'ADMINISTRATOR'). Must match user capabilities.

ipmi_retries.description: Number of times to retry an IPMI operation after failure.

ipmi_timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for an IPMI command response before timing out.

ipmi_tls_disable_cert_check.description: If true (not recommended), disable TLS certificate validation for lanplus connections (e.g., with self-signed certs).

ipmi_user.description: Username to authenticate with the IPMI BMC. Must have sufficient privileges. Required.

auth_type.description: Authentication method. Currently only 'password' is widely supported.

auth_url.description: Keystone Identity API endpoint URL (e.g., https://keystone.example.com:5000/v3). Required.

ca_cert.description: Absolute path to a CA certificate bundle for secure connections. Leave empty to use system trust store.

default_action.description: Fallback fencing action if not specified at invocation (on/off/reboot/status/list/monitor).

domain_name.description: Domain name for the project (Keystone v3). Usually 'Default' unless using custom domains.

endpoint_type.description: Preferred Ironic service endpoint type (public/internal/admin), in order of precedence.

extra_headers.description: Semicolon-separated list of HTTP headers to add to requests (e.g., 'X-Forwarded-For:10.0.0.1;X-Custom:abc').

insecure.description: If true, skip SSL certificate verification (not recommended for production).

ironic_api_version.description: Ironic API version to use. Set to '1' for current stable (Pike+).

node.description: UUID (preferred) or name of the Ironic node to fence. Required.

password.description: Password for the OpenStack user. Recommended to be stored in a secure credential store or environment.

project_domain_name.description: Domain name of the project (Keystone v3).

project_name.description: Name of the OpenStack project (tenant) containing the Ironic node.

region_name.description: OpenStack region to use (e.g., 'RegionOne'). Leave blank if single-region or not applicable.

retry.description: Number of times to retry a failed operation (e.g., network glitch).

retry_max_delay.description: Maximum delay (seconds) between retries, used for exponential backoff.

secure.description: If false, disable SSL/TLS (only use for testing on trusted networks).

timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for each OpenStack API call before timing out.

user_domain_name.description: Domain name of the user (Keystone v3).

debug_file.description: Write debug information to given file Obsoletes: debug.

delay.description: Wait X seconds before fencing is started.

disable_timeout.description: Disable timeout (true/false) (default: true when run from Pacemaker 2.0+).

login_timeout.description: Wait X seconds for cmd prompt after login.

plug_separator.description: Separator for plug parameter when specifying more than 1 plug.

power_timeout.description: Test X seconds for status change after ON/OFF.

power_wait.description: Wait X seconds after issuing ON/OFF.

quiet.description: Disable logging to stderr. Does not affect --verbose or --debug-file or logging to syslog.

retry_on.description: Count of attempts to retry power on.

separator.description: Separator for CSV created by 'list' operation.

shell_timeout.description: Wait X seconds for cmd prompt after issuing command.

ssl_insecure.description: Use SSL connection without verifying certificate.

stonith_status_sleep.description: Sleep X seconds between status calls during a STONITH action.

verbose.description: Verbose mode. Multiple -v flags can be stacked on the command line.

verbose_level.description: Level of debugging detail in output. Defaults to the number of --verbose flags specified on the command line, or to 1 if verbose=1.

auth_url.description: Keystone identity endpoint URL. Must include the path and version.

auth_version.description: OpenStack Identity API version (typically '2' or '3'). Use '3' for modern deployments.

ca_file.description: Path to CA certificate bundle file for TLS verification. Omit if using system CA store.

domain_name.description: Domain name for user/project (required for Keystone v3+). Leave empty if using v2.0.

insecure.description: Skip SSL certificate verification. Only enable in lab/test environments.

nova_endpoint.description: Override Nova service endpoint (e.g., 'https://nova.region.example.com:8774/v2.1'). Defaults to catalog lookup.

password.description: Password for the service account. Should be stored securely (e.g., via vault or file permissions).

project_id.description: Optional project (tenant) ID. Use if you want to avoid name lookup (e.g., for multi-region or name collisions).

project_name.description: Project (tenant) name for the service account used to perform fencing.

region_name.description: OpenStack region containing the Nova compute resources to fence.

retry_count.description: Maximum number of retry attempts per fencing action.

retry_max_delay.description: Maximum delay (in seconds) between retries. Delay increases exponentially up to this value.

retry_timeout.description: Total timeout (in seconds) for a fencing operation (sum of retries).

trust_id.description: Optional trust ID for delegation (used in advanced trust-scoped scenarios).

username.description: Service account username with Nova 'admin' role on target project.

debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging to stderr

email.description: Reboot notification email — always required per fence_ovh(8) man page

legacy_api.description: Use legacy /api/ovh endpoint instead of /api/me (required for some older OVH accounts)

ovh_endpoint.description: OVH API endpoint region (e.g., ovh-eu, ovh-ca, kimsufi-eu, soyoustart-eu)

password.description: Login password or passphrase

password_script.description: Script to run to retrieve password

retry.description: Number of times to retry failed API calls

timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for each API request

api_url.description: Base URL of the RHEV-M (oVirt Engine) API endpoint.

default_action.description: Default fence action (e.g., 'on', 'off', 'reboot', 'status', 'list') if not specified in the command line.

password.description: Password for the RHEV-M API user. Store securely (e.g., via file permissions or vault integration).

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the VirtualBox host system (where VBoxHeadless/VirtualBox runs)

retry_count.description: Number of times to retry a failed fence operation.

pid_file.description: Path to the PID file

ssl_cert_path.description: Path to the SSL certificate file

ssl_enabled.description: Enable SSL/TLS on a separate listener

timeout_server.description: Timeout (seconds) waiting for response from backend servers

transparent.description: Enable transparent proxy mode (typically used when proxy sits in-line on the network path)

max_file_age.description: Maximum time (in seconds) to retain a queued file before automatic deletion.

max_file_count.description: Maximum number of files allowed in the spool directory before rejection.

max_file_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) allowed for a single file in the spool.

spool_dir.description: Base directory where files are staged for processing.

verbose.description: Enable detailed logging for debugging and monitoring.

worker_count.description: Number of worker threads to process queued files.

auth_token_rootcertbundle.description: Path to CA bundle for validating token signatures

auth_token_service.description: Token service name (must match issuer expectation)

debug_addr.description: Address for debug endpoints (health, metrics, pprof)

gcs_bucket.description: GCS bucket name for registry storage

gcs_keyid.description: KMS key ID for GCS encryption (optional)

gcs_private_key.description: Base64-encoded private key JSON (for service account auth)

gcs_user_project.description: GCP project ID to bill for access (if bucket is requester-pays)

health_storagedriver_enabled.description: Enable health endpoint that checks storage driver connectivity

health_storagedriver_threshold.description: Number of failed checks before marking unhealthy

http_addr.description: HTTP listener address (host:port) for registry API

log_environment.description: Environment tag added to log entries (e.g., production, staging, dev)

log_file.description: Enable file logging (if true, logs written to /var/log/registry/registry.log)

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level: debug, info, warning, error, or critical

notifications_enabled.description: Enable webhook notifications on image pushes/pulls

proxy_remoteurl.description: Upstream registry URL (for pull-through caching, e.g., https://registry-1.docker.io)

tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS/HTTPS on the registry API

tls_key.description: Path to TLS private key (PEM format)

tls_keystore.description: Path to TLS certificate chain (PEM format)

base_url.description: Optional URL prefix for deployment behind a reverse proxy (e.g., '/files' when proxied at https://example.com/files). Leave empty for root deployment.

https_enabled.description: Enable HTTPS/TLS encryption. If true, SSL certificate and key paths must be configured.

node_id.description: Short string that identifies the node. Used in generated URLs and peer relay.

port.description: TCP port the HTTP service listens on.

ssl_cert.description: Absolute path to the SSL certificate file (PEM format). Required when https_enabled is true.
