db_host.description: Hostname or IP of PostgreSQL server (only used if db_type is 'postgresql')

db_name.description: Database name for PostgreSQL (only used if db_type is 'postgresql')

db_password.description: Password for PostgreSQL database user (only used if db_type is 'postgresql')

db_path.description: File path for SQLite database (only used if db_type is 'sqlite')

db_port.description: Port of PostgreSQL server (only used if db_type is 'postgresql')

db_type.description: Database backend to use for persistent storage

db_user.description: Database user for PostgreSQL (only used if db_type is 'postgresql')

listen_interface.description: Network interface to bind to; use '127.0.0.1' to restrict to local connections

listen_port.description: Port on which the MUC service listens for incoming connections

log_file.description: Path to the log file (use '-' for stdout)

log_level.description: Verbosity level for service logs

max_history_messages.description: Upper bound on number of history messages that may be requested per room

max_occupants.description: Global maximum number of occupants allowed across all rooms

max_rooms_per_user.description: Maximum number of MUC rooms a single user may create

room_default_history.description: Default number of historical messages sent to new occupants (or 'never', 'from_join', 'from_subscribe', 'integer')

room_default_name.description: Default room name shown in discovery listings

service_jid.description: JID (Jabber ID) of the MUC service as seen by clients (e.g., muc.example.com)

service_name.description: Human-readable name for the MUC service

tls_cert_file.description: Path to the TLS certificate file (PEM format)

tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS encryption for connections (recommended for production)

tls_key_file.description: Path to the TLS private key file (PEM format)

auth_backend.description: Authentication backend: 'local' for internal user DB, 'mysql' or 'ldap' for external.

auth_timeout.description: Seconds allowed for a client to complete authentication.

idle_timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity before disconnecting a client.

ldap_basedn.description: Base DN to search for users.

ldap_binddn.description: DN to bind as for user lookups.

ldap_bindpass.description: Password for bind DN (use secure storage).

ldap_filter.description: LDAP search filter; %u is replaced by the username.

ldap_scope.description: LDAP search scope: base, one, or sub.

ldap_uri.description: LDAP server URI (e.g., ldap://host/ or ldaps://host/).

listen_host.description: IP address or hostname to bind the listener to.

listen_port.description: Port on which c2s listens for client connections.

log_file.description: Path to the c2s log file.

log_level.description: Minimum log level to record.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

mysql_pass.description: MySQL password for the user (use secure storage).

quota_messages_per_minute.description: Maximum number of messages a user can send per minute.

quota_sessions_per_user.description: Maximum concurrent sessions allowed per user.

tls_ca_file.description: Optional: Path to CA certificate bundle for client cert verification.

tls_cert_file.description: Path to the server certificate file for TLS.

tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS encryption for client connections.

tls_key_file.description: Path to the server private key file for TLS (can be same as cert file).

tls_verify_mode.description: Level of client certificate verification (none, request, require, optional).

device.description: Audio device identifier (e.g., hw:0, hw:1, card:device)

enable_port_check.description: Enable strict port type checking (recommended only for debugging)

engine.description: Audio backend engine (e.g., alsa, dummy, net)

period.description: Frames per period — smaller values reduce latency but increase CPU load

periods.description: Number of periods — determines total buffer depth (frames = period × periods)

rt_priority.description: Real-time priority level (1–99); set to 0 to disable real-time scheduling

use_hw_monitor.description: Enable hardware monitor outputs (e.g., for loopback or direct monitoring)

authenticator_class.description: Authenticator backend class to handle user login (e.g., PAM, OAuth, LDAP, or custom).

base_url.description: Public base URL path for the JupyterHub (e.g., '/hub/' or 'https://hub.example.com/')

concurrent_spawn_limit.description: Maximum number of user servers that may be spawned concurrently.

cwd.description: Base directory for JupyterHub configuration, logs, and data files.

daemonize.description: Whether to run JupyterHub as a background daemon process.

db_archive_max_age.description: Maximum age (in seconds) for database entries before archiving. Set to 0 to disable.

db_url.description: Database connection string. Use SQLite for single-node deployments; PostgreSQL or MySQL for production scaling.

docker_image.description: Default Docker image used to spawn single-user servers (used only if spawner supports Docker).

hub_ip.description: IP address the Hub binds to (usually localhost or internal network).

hub_port.description: Port the Hub binds to for internal communication.

idle_timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity before an idle user server is stopped. 0 = disabled.

proxy_api_ip.description: IP address for the ConfigurableHTTPProxy's internal API.

proxy_api_port.description: Port for the ConfigurableHTTPProxy's internal API.

spawner_class.description: Spawner backend to launch user servers (e.g., local process, Docker, Kubernetes).

ssl_certfile.description: Path to SSL certificate file. Leave empty to disable HTTPS.

ssl_keyfile.description: Path to SSL private key file. Required if using SSL/TLS.

device.description: Optional input device path (e.g., '/dev/input/event0') to apply layout only to a specific keyboard. Leave blank to configure all keyboards system-wide.

layout.description: Primary keyboard layout (e.g., 'us', 'de', 'fr', 'ru'). Use comma-separated values for multilingual setups (e.g., 'us,ru').

model.description: Physical keyboard model. 'pc105' is standard for most PCs. Other common values include 'pc104', 'pc102', 'sun5'.

options.description: XKB options to customize behavior (e.g., switching layout with Alt+Shift, swapping Caps Lock and Ctrl). Leave empty for defaults.

rules.description: XKB ruleset. 'base' works for most distributions; 'evdev' is used on some systems for better hardware support.

variant.description: Optional layout variant(s) corresponding to each layout (e.g., 'dvorak', 'nodeadkeys'). Leave empty if using default variant(s).

control_socket_path.description: Unix socket path for the Kea DHCP control socket.

default_rebind_timer.description: Global default T2 rebind timer (fraction of valid_lifetime).

default_renew_timer.description: Global default T1 renewal timer (fraction of valid_lifetime).

default_valid_lifetime.description: Global default lease lifetime in seconds for clients not covered by per-subnet values.

hooks_lease_file_path.description: Path to the hooks library for lease file updates (e.g., CSV lease file logging).

interface_re_detect.description: If true, Kea will re-detect interfaces periodically; usually false in stable environments.

lease_database_host.description: Database server hostname (used when lease_database_type is mysql/postgresql).

lease_database_name.description: Name of the database (for SQL backends) or path to lease CSV file (for 'memfile').

lease_database_password.description: Password for the lease database user (used when lease_database_type is mysql/postgresql).

lease_database_port.description: Database server port (used when lease_database_type is mysql/postgresql).

lease_database_type.description: Type of backend for storing lease data. 'memfile' stores leases in CSV files; 'mysql'/'postgresql' use relational databases.

lease_database_user.description: Database user with access to the lease database (used when lease_database_type is mysql/postgresql).

lease_file_cleanup_interval.description: Interval in seconds between lease file cleanup cycles (used when lease_database_type is 'memfile').

log_debuglevel.description: Debug verbosity level (0–99); only used in DEBUG mode.

log_flush.description: If true, flush log after each write (useful for debugging, may impact performance).

log_global_debuglevel.description: Global debug level (overrides per-logger if set).

log_global_severity.description: Global log severity (overrides per-logger if set).

log_max_size.description: Maximum log file size in bytes before rotation (e.g., 10 MB).

log_max_ver.description: Maximum number of rotated log files to retain.

log_severity.description: Log severity for Kea DHCP4 process.

server_id_type.description: Algorithm used to generate server identifier (Hardware MAC-based is standard for DHCPv4).

server_id_value.description: Explicit server identifier value (usually left blank and auto-generated when server_id_type='hardware').

keystone_assignment_driver.description: Backend driver for managing role/project/user assignments.

keystone_catalog_driver.description: Backend driver for service catalog (list of endpoints per service).

keystone_credential_driver.description: Storage backend for credentials (e.g., fernet for encrypted key rotation).

keystone_database_connection.description: Database connection URI. Supports MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite (for dev).

keystone_default_deployment_name.description: Logical name for this deployment; used in logs and to disambiguate multi-tenancy.

keystone_endpoint_policy_driver.description: Backend for endpoint access control policies.

keystone_eventlet_server_admin_port.description: Port for admin-only API endpoints (e.g., user management).

keystone_eventlet_server_bind_host.description: Network interface for public API server (v2/v3).

keystone_eventlet_server_enable_ssl.description: Enable HTTPS for the API endpoints.

keystone_eventlet_server_max_request_bod.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of request body allowed (DOCS: default ~112 KiB).

keystone_eventlet_server_ssl_ca_certs.description: Path to CA bundle for client certificate verification (mTLS).

keystone_eventlet_server_ssl_certfile.description: Path to SSL certificate file (required if SSL is enabled).

keystone_eventlet_server_ssl_keyfile.description: Path to SSL private key file (required if SSL is enabled).

keystone_eventlet_server_workers.description: Number of worker processes for handling requests.

keystone_federation_driver.description: Backend for federated identity (SAML, OpenID Connect, etc.).

keystone_fernet_tokens_key_repository.description: Path to directory storing Fernet token keys. Must be writable and synced across nodes.

keystone_ldap_url.description: LDAP server URL (required only if using LDAP backend).

keystone_paste_deploy_config.description: PasteDeploy config path defining WSGI pipeline and middleware.

keystone_redis_url.description: Redis connection URL for token storage or caching (e.g., 'redis://redis:6379').

keystone_resource_driver.description: Backend driver for managing projects and domains.

keystone_signing_certfile.description: Path to PKI signing certificate (legacy PKI tokens only).

keystone_signing_keyfile.description: Path to PKI signing private key (legacy PKI tokens only).

keystone_token_cache_driver.description: Backend for caching token metadata (e.g., sql, memcache).

keystone_token_expiration.description: Token lifetime in seconds. Shorter = more secure, more overhead.

keystone_token_expire_on_revocation.description: Immediately expire revoked tokens (requires driver support).

keystone_token_max_concurrent.description: Max simultaneous active tokens per user.

keystone_token_pki_revocation_cache.description: Enable PKI revocation cache (legacy PKI tokens only).

keystone_token_revocation_driver.description: Backend for token revocation list (e.g., sql, redis, memcache).

keystone_token_use_cache.description: Enable caching of token lookups for improved performance.

keystone_tokenless_auth_driver.description: Backend for tokenless auth flows (e.g., OAuth1).

identity.description: Server identity string used in logs and responses. Should be a short hostname or identifier.

log_file.description: Optional path to KNOT log file. Leave empty to use system logging (e.g., systemd-journald or syslog).

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging. Choose from: critical, error, warning, notice, info, debug.

max_concurrent_queries.description: Maximum concurrent queries per worker thread. 0 means use KNOT's internal default.

max_open_files.description: Maximum number of open files (ulimit). 0 means use system default limit.

pid_file.description: Path to the PID file for the KNOT daemon.

workers.description: Number of worker threads. 0 means auto-detect based on CPU cores. Minimum 1 if explicitly set.

zonefile_dir.description: Directory where zone files are stored. Must be writable by knot user.

log.level.description: Verbosity level: 0 (none) to 6 (debug); 4=notice is a good default for production

log.logfile.description: Path to a file for log output; empty disables file logging

log.syslog.description: Send log output to syslog instead of standard error

main.connection_type.description: Type of physical connection: 'tpuarts' (serial), 'ip' (tunnel/routing over IP), etc.

main.device.description: Device path to the physical KNX interface (e.g., serial port or /dev/knxd)

main.enable.description: Enable the main knxd daemon (if false, knxd starts but does not process EIB frames)

main.name.description: Name of this knxd instance (used in logging and discovery)

mcast.address.description: Multicast group address for KNXnet/IP routing

mcast.interface.description: Network interface name for multicast (e.g., 'eth0'); empty = let system decide

mcast.port.description: UDP port used for multicast KNX traffic

security.password_enable.description: Require passwords for client connections to the server

security.password_file.description: Path to file containing base64-encoded passwords (see knxd docs for format)

server.bind.description: IP address to bind the server to (e.g., '0.0.0.0' for all, '127.0.0.1' for local-only)

server.enable.description: Enable the built-in KNX server for EIBnet/IP tunneling/routing

server.multicast_enable.description: Enable multicast KNXnet/IP routing (requires compatible network infrastructure)

usb.product_id.description: USB product ID for KNX USB devices (hex string)

usb.vendor_id.description: USB vendor ID for KNX USB devices (hex string); typical for Philips/KNX devices

pam_id_disable.description: Disable ID resolution via PAM (e.g., if only authentication is needed).

pam_offline_expiration.description: Number of days after which cached credentials expire when offline (0 = never expire).

default_directory_permission.description: Octal permission mask applied to new directories (if inherit_permissions=false).

default_file_permission.description: Octal permission mask applied to new files (if inherit_permissions=false).

inherit_owner.description: If enabled, new files/dirs inherit parent directory’s ownership (owner and group).

inherit_permissions.description: If enabled, new files/dirs inherit parent directory's permissions.

log_file.description: Absolute path to the log file. Set to empty string to disable logging to file (logs only to syslog).

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging: 0 (none) to 10 (debug). Higher values increase I/O and log size.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous connections to the server. With max connections = 0, the value will be set to the maximum allowed number of 65536.

netbios_name.description: NetBIOS name of the server as seen by Windows clients.

server_signing.description: Enable SMB packet signing for integrity and anti-replay protection. Options: 'yes', 'no', 'auto', 'disabled', 'mandatory'. Default is disabled.

tcp_port.description: TCP port that is listened to. Typically 445.

unix_extensions.description: Enable SMB Unix extensions for POSIX semantics (required for Linux/macOS clients).

workgroup.description: Windows workgroup or domain name. Must match the clients’ workgroup for unauthenticated access.

cache_ttl_seconds.description: Time in seconds to cache LDAP results. Set to 0 to disable caching.

daemon_host.description: IP address or hostname to bind the daemon to (empty string means bind to all interfaces).

daemon_port.description: Port number on which the LAM daemon listens for incoming HTTP requests.

db_driver.description: Database backend for LAM daemon. Currently only 'sqlite' is supported.

db_file.description: Path to SQLite database file (used if db_driver = sqlite).

ldap_basedn.description: Base DN under which user/group entries are stored in LDAP.

ldap_binddn.description: DN to bind as for LDAP searches (empty = anonymous bind).

ldap_bindpw.description: Password for the bind DN. Leave empty if using anonymous or external auth (e.g., SASL/GSSAPI).

ldap_cacert.description: Absolute path to CA certificate file for verifying LDAP server TLS certificates. Empty disables verification.

ldap_starttls.description: Enable StartTLS to upgrade plain LDAP connections to TLS.

log_file.description: Absolute path to the main log file.

log_level.description: Verbosity level for daemon logging. Options: debug, info, notice, warning, error, critical.

pid_file.description: Absolute path to the PID file used by the daemon.

request_log_file.description: Path to the request log file (only used if request_logging is enabled).

request_logging.description: Enable logging of individual requests (URL, method, client IP, response status).

ssl_cert_path.description: Absolute path to the SSL certificate file (required if SSL enabled).

ssl_enabled.description: Enable HTTPS (SSL/TLS) for incoming daemon connections.

ssl_key_path.description: Absolute path to the SSL private key file (required if SSL enabled).

worker_count.description: Number of worker processes to spawn for handling requests.

base_dn.description: Default base DN for LDAP searches (e.g., 'dc=myorg,dc=local')

bind_dn.description: Default bind DN for client tools (e.g., 'cn=admin,dc=example,dc=com'); leave empty to bind anonymously

bind_pw.description: Password for default bind DN. If empty, tools will prompt interactively. Not stored in config for security.

ldap_version.description: LDAP protocol version to use (1, 2, or 3); typically 3

referrals.description: How to handle referrals: 'follow' (automatically chase), 'stop' (do not chase)

sasl_authcid.description: SASL authentication identity (e.g., principal name for GSSAPI)

sasl_enabled.description: Enable SASL authentication (e.g., GSSAPI for Kerberos)

sasl_mech.description: SASL mechanism to use when SASL is enabled

sasl_realm.description: SASL realm (Kerberos realm for GSSAPI); leave empty to auto-detect

sizelimit.description: Maximum number of entries to return from a search; 0 means unlimited

timelimit.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for a server connection; 0 means unlimited

tls_ca_cert_path.description: Path to CA certificate bundle for TLS verification

uri.description: LDAP server URI(s) — space-separated for failover (e.g., 'ldap://ldap1.example.com ldap://ldap2.example.com')

cni_conf_dir.description: Path to CNI network configuration directory.

debug_level.description: Log level for containerd (debug, info, warn, error, etc.).

default_runtime_name.description: Default container runtime to use for containers (e.g., 'runc', 'kata-runtime').

devmapper_pool_name.description: Device mapper pool name (if using devmapper snapshotter).

enable_cri.description: Enable the CRI plugin to support Kubernetes container runtime API.

grpc_address.description: Unix socket path for containerd gRPC API.

grpc_max_recv_message_size.description: Maximum gRPC receive message size in bytes.

grpc_max_send_message_size.description: Maximum gRPC send message size in bytes.

image_deletion.description: Enable automatic deletion of unused images (recommended in production).

image_pull_timeout.description: Timeout for image pull operations in seconds (0 = unlimited).

max_container_log_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of container stdout/stderr logs.

metrics_interval.description: Interval (seconds) between metric exports (set to 0 to disable).

no_pivot.description: Disable pivot root (not recommended for production — useful only in constrained environments).

overlayfs_native_diff.description: Use native diff algorithm for overlayfs snapshots (slower but accurate; fallback if 'diff' fails).

pprof_enabled.description: Enable pprof CPU/memory profiling endpoint (disabled by default).

privileged_without_host_devices.description: Grant privileges to containers without exposing host devices (Kubernetes-specific).

root_dir.description: Root directory for persistent containerd data (snapshots, image layers).

sandbox_image.description: Image used for Kubernetes sandbox (pause) containers.

snapshotter.description: Default snapshotter used for container filesystem layers (e.g., 'overlayfs', 'btrfs', 'devmapper').

state_dir.description: Directory for containerd runtime state (sockets, PID files, etc.).

cookie_domain.description: Domain for authentication cookies (e.g., .example.com). If empty, defaults to portal hostname.

cookie_secure.description: Require HTTPS for cookies (set to false only for testing or internal HTTP deployments)

custom_css.description: Path to custom CSS (relative to /static/ or absolute URL)

custom_js.description: Path to custom JavaScript (relative to /static/ or absolute URL)

debug.description: Enable debug mode: verbose logging, expose internal info to users

enable_portal.description: Enable the portal interface (login, profile, password change). Set to false for API-only deployments (e.g., embedded authentication)

log_backend.description: Logging destination: syslog, file, stderr, or none

log_level.description: Logging verbosity: debug, info, notice, warn, error, crit, alert, emerg

log_priority.description: Priority threshold for logging (only messages at or above this level are logged)

maintenance.description: Enable maintenance mode: temporarily disable login and session renewal

oauth2_enabled.description: Enable OAuth2 authorization server features (token endpoint, introspection)

oidc_enabled.description: Enable OpenID Connect provider features (discovery, token endpoint, userinfo)

portal_url.description: Public URL of the LemonLDAP-NG portal (used for redirects, cookies, and links)

saml_enabled.description: Enable SAML 2.0 identity and service provider support

secret_key.description: Secret key (≥32 chars) used to sign cookies and tokens. Must be kept secret. Auto-generated on first run.

webfinger_enabled.description: Enable WebFinger support for decentralized identity resolution (.well-known/webfinger)

file_charset.description: Character encoding used for local filenames and directory listings

ftp_passive.description: Enable or disable passive FTP mode

ftp_proxy.description: FTP proxy host:port; empty string disables proxy

ftp_user.description: Default username used for anonymous or basic FTP logins

locale.description: Locale used for message translation and character encoding (e.g., en_US.UTF-8)

mirror_parallel.description: Maximum number of parallel transfers during mirroring

mirror_parallel_min_size.description: Minimum file size (bytes) to trigger parallel transfer

net_max_retries.description: Maximum number of retries for failed operations (0 = unlimited)

net_socket_buffer.description: Size of network socket buffer in bytes

protocol.description: Default protocol used when connecting (ftp, ftps, sftp, http, https)

ssl_ca_file.description: Path to CA certificate bundle file for SSL verification

ssl_verify_certificate.description: Enable or disable SSL certificate verification (required for secure connections)

xfer_log.description: Path to transfer log file (empty = no log)

xfer_log_syslog.description: Enable logging of transfers to syslog

xfer_log_time_format.description: Format string for timestamps in log entries

detailed_cache_mon.description: Enable or disable collection of detailed per-level cache metrics (L1, L2, L3).

device_path.description: Path to the RDT (Resource Director Technology) device. Usually /dev/rdt.

log_file.description: File path where monitoring logs and reports will be written.

max_clos.description: Maximum number of Cache Monitoring (CLOS) groups the system supports.

monitor.description: Enable or disable monitoring of cache and memory bandwidth.

poll_interval_ms.description: Interval (in milliseconds) at which monitoring data is sampled.

access_log_path.description: Explicit path to access log file(s); supports wildcards (e.g., '/var/log/squid/access.log*'). Leave empty for auto-discovery under log_dir.

base_url.description: Public-facing base URL for the web report interface (e.g., http://server.example.com/lightsquid).

custom_log_format.description: Custom log format string (only used when log_format=custom). Must match Squid/HTTP log tokens.

db_password.description: Database password (used only if db_type=mysql). Leave empty for no password.

db_path.description: Path to SQLite database file (used only if db_type=sqlite).

db_timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for database lock (SQLite/MySQL).

ignore_errors.description: If true, skip malformed log lines instead of stopping the parser.

lang.description: Language code for report UI and titles; must match a locale file in 'lang/' directory.

log_dir.description: Directory containing raw Squid-style access logs to analyze.

log_format.description: Format of input log files: 'squid' (default), 'apache', 'combined', or 'custom'.

max_days.description: Maximum number of days of historical per-day report data to retain; 0 = keep all.

report_dir.description: Directory where generated HTML reports and cached data will be stored.

syslog.description: Log internal messages to syslog in addition to stderr.

time_report.description: Enable time-based reports: daily, weekly, monthly averages and trends.

timezone.description: PHP-compatible timezone string for time-based reports (e.g., 'America/New_York').

url_detail.description: Enable detailed per-URL (path-level) breakdown (may increase report size).

user_bandwidth.description: Enable per-user bandwidth summary (in MB) in reports.

user_detail.description: Enable detailed per-user breakdown in reports (e.g., hits, bytes, time ranges).

web_auth_enabled.description: Enable HTTP basic authentication for the built-in web server.

web_bind_ip.description: IP address to bind the built-in web server to (0.0.0.0 for all interfaces).

web_enable.description: Enable built-in simple HTTP server for report access (use only for local dev or testing).

web_htpasswd_file.description: Path to htpasswd file for basic auth credentials (only used if web_auth_enabled=true).

web_port.description: TCP port for the built-in web server.

web_root.description: Path to Lightsquid's web asset directory (HTML, CSS, images). Usually auto-detected.

ptp_accept_any_master.description: If true, accept sync from any master—even those in a different domain.

ptp_boundary_clock_jb.description: If true, operate as a boundary clock (forward messages). Otherwise, ordinary clock.

ptp_clock_device.description: Path to the PTP clock device (e.g., /dev/ptp0). Auto-detected if empty.

ptp_clock_identity.description: 64-bit hexadecimal clock identity (e.g., '00:1B:44:00:00:00:00:01'). If left empty, auto-generated.

ptp_delay_req_interval.description: Delay request interval exponent (optional; defaults to sync_interval if omitted).

ptp_domain_number.description: PTP domain number (0–127). All devices in the same domain must use the same value.

ptp_interface.description: Network interface used for PTP traffic. Required for deterministic behavior.

ptp_log_level.description: Log verbosity level (0 = all, 7 = none). Recommend 6–7 in production to reduce noise. In config file, use 'logging_level', not 'logLevel'.

ptp_max_steps.description: Maximum hops allowed in Announce messages (255 = no limit). In config file, use 'maxStepsRemoved'.

ptp_p2p_delay_req_interval.description: Delay request interval exponent for p2p mode (optional; defaults to sync_interval if omitted).

ptp_slave_only.description: If true, never act as a master—always slave. Use clientOnly in config.

ptp_sync_interval.description: Sync message interval exponent. Values: -12 (244 µs) to 3 (8 s). Default -3 (1 s).

ptp_sync_loss_timeout.description: Seconds of missed sync before clock goes into unlocked/frozen state. 0 = immediate.

ptp_transport.description: Transport mode: 'udp' (IP-based) or 'l2' (Layer-2 raw Ethernet frames).

ptp_unicast_only.description: If true, ptp4l will only communicate with explicitly configured unicast masters.

ptp_use_hardware_timestamps.description: Use hardware-assisted PTP timestamping if available. Highly recommended for sub-µs accuracy.

auth_pass.description: Password for SMTP authentication (if required). Keep secure (e.g., via file perms).

auth_user.description: Username for SMTP authentication (if required by relay). Leave blank if not using auth.

ca_cert_file.description: Path to CA certificate bundle for TLS verification (e.g., system default).

debug.description: Enable debug logging to stderr (for troubleshooting only).

default_domain.description: Domain to append to addresses missing a domain (e.g., 'localhost').

from_line_override.description: Allow overriding the 'From:' header for root's outgoing mail (set to YES to enable).

hostname.description: Hostname to send in the SMTP HELO/EHLO command. Empty means use system hostname.

mailhub.description: SMTP relay server (hostname or IP) with optional port (e.g., 'smtp.gmail.com:587').

rewrite_domain.description: Domain to append to all outgoing 'From:' addresses (e.g., 'example.com').

root_user.description: Email address (or local user) that receives mail for the root user.

tls_cert_check.description: Verify the relay's certificate against CA bundle. Disable only in testing (insecure).

use_starttls.description: Explicitly use STARTTLS negotiation (ignored if UseTLS is NO).

use_tls.description: Enable TLS encryption (STARTTLS or implicit TLS) for the connection to the relay.

backend.description: Logging destination; either 'syslog' (system logging) or 'file' (dedicated log file)

follow_symlinks.description: Whether to follow symbolic links when monitoring directory trees

generate_pngs.description: If true, generate PNG graph files in addition to HTML and logs. Set to false for log-only mode.

html_title.description: Title shown on MRTG HTML pages (e.g., 'Network Traffic – Datacenter A').

interval.description: Polling interval in seconds. Standard is 300 (5 minutes). Must match cron/daemon schedule to avoid gaps or double-sampling.

log_errors.description: If true, write errors to stderr (helpful during initial setup or troubleshooting).

log_syslog.description: If true, send log messages to syslog (e.g., for centralized logging).

mrtg_bin.description: Absolute path to the MRTG binary (if installed nonstandard). Usually left as default.

use_24_hour_time.description: If true, use 24-hour format in timestamps; otherwise uses 12-hour (AM/PM).

use_timezone.description: Timezone for timestamps (e.g., 'UTC', 'America/New_York'). Avoid 'local' in distributed environments.

work_dir.description: Directory where MRTG stores generated HTML pages, graphs (PNGs), and log files. Must be writable by the MRTG user.

write_pid_file.description: Path to PID file if daemon_mode=true. Required for service management (e.g., stop/start/restart).

audio.enable_denoising.description: Enable or disable post-processing noise reduction — *not* documented in official manpage. Removed default; default should be false.

audio.output_format.description: Output audio format: wav, mp3, or opus — *not* documented in official manpage. Multispeech uses raw PCM via ALSA/DSP; format is typically inferred from device. Retained for compatibility.

audio.sample_rate.description: Audio sample rate in Hz; manpage default for tone sampling is 44100 but for generic audio output no fixed sample_rate is documented — this field likely misplaces tone.sampling into audio. Still retained as de facto standard.

backend.host.description: Hostname or IP address of the backend speech server

backend.port.description: Port number for the backend server API

frontend.dtk_voices.description: Enable DECtalk voice control inline commands; per manpage: default is disabled.

frontend.native_voices.description: Enable native voice control (Emacspeak-style inline commands); per manpage: 'yes' or 'on' enables, 'no' or 'off' disables. Default: yes.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity: debug, info, warning, error, or critical

logging.file.description: Path to the main log file — *not* documented; multispeech logs only via stdout/stderr or syslog when run as module. Retained for compatibility.

logging.max_backup_count.description: Number of rotated log files to retain — *not* documented. Removed.

logging.max_size_mb.description: Maximum log file size in MB before rotation — *not* documented. Removed.

max_buffer_size.description: Maximum buffer size (in bytes) for audio output

max_workers.description: Maximum number of concurrent speech synthesis workers

speech.default_language.description: Default language code (e.g., en, ru, de, fr, es, pt, it, autodetect)

speech.engine.description: Speech synthesis engine to use (e.g., espeak, mbrola, freephone, ru_tts, user); default per manpage is 'espeak'

timeout_ms.description: Maximum time (in milliseconds) allowed for a synthesis request

bonjour_enabled.description: Publish server via Bonjour/Zeroconf for automatic discovery

enable_registration.description: Allow users to register accounts via client (insecure on public servers)

host.description: IP address or hostname to bind to (empty = all interfaces)

ice_no_tcp.description: Disable TCP fallback for ICE connectivity (legacy clients only)

log_file_path.description: Path to log file; empty means write to stderr/stdout

log_level.description: Logging verbosity: 0=none, 1=errors, 2=warnings, 3=info, 4=debug

max_bandwidth.description: Total audio bandwidth in bits per second (per-user limit is 1/3 of this)

opus_dtx.description: Enable discontinuous transmission to save bandwidth during silence

pid_file_path.description: Path for PID file (created on startup)

port.description: TCP port for client connections (must be open in firewall)

server_password.description: Password required for clients to connect (leave blank for open server)

silence_threshold.description: Silence detection threshold (0.0–1.0); lower = more sensitive

ssl_ca_path.description: Optional: Path to CA chain file for client certificate validation

ssl_cert_path.description: Absolute path to TLS certificate (required for encrypted connections)

ssl_key_path.description: Absolute path to TLS private key (must be readable by mumble user)

super_user_password.description: Initial SuperUser password; must be set once during first login

udp_packet_size.description: Max UDP packet size in bytes (0 = auto-detect)

web_cert_path.description: TLS certificate for web interface (if enabled)

web_enable.description: Enable built-in web interface (requires external mumble-website backend)

web_host.description: Interface for web interface binding (127.0.0.1 for localhost only)

web_key_path.description: TLS private key for web interface

web_port.description: Port for web interface (0 = auto-select; typically 8080)

group.description: Group under which the munin-node daemon runs

user.description: User under which the munin-node daemon runs

contact_always_send.description: Send alerts even when state hasn't changed (e.g., status reminders).

htmldir.description: Directory where Munin generates HTML and static files.

include_dir.description: Directory containing additional configuration files to include.

logdir.description: Directory for Munin logs (node connections, errors).

munin_graph.description: Path to the Munin graph generation script.

munin_html.description: Path to the Munin HTML generator script.

munin_logcheck.description: Path to the Munin log-checking utility.

munin_master.description: Path to the Munin master process executable.

munin_update.description: Path to the Munin data collector script.

vardir.description: Directory for storing RRD databases and cache files.

web_enabled.description: Enable the Munin web interface (HTML + graphs).

admin_autosync.description: Automatically sync ban list and admin files with disk on changes.

admin_enabled.description: Enable built-in admin system for permissions and authentication.

admin_file.description: Path to admin user/permission configuration file.

allow_download.description: Allow clients to download custom models/sounds/maps from this server.

bind.description: Network interface or IP to bind to for game traffic. Use '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces.

dedicated.description: Run as a dedicated server (no local console or graphics).

fraglimit.description: Match frag limit. 0 disables frag-based ending (use timelimit or roundlimit).

friendlyfire.description: Allow team members to damage each other.

host.description: Server IP address to bind to. Use '0.0.0.0' to listen on all interfaces.

hostname.description: Server name displayed in the server browser and console.

log_file_enabled.description: Enable logging to a file (see logfile setting).

log_filepath.description: Path to the server log file.

log_max_files.description: Number of rotated log files to retain.

log_max_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) before log rotation. 0 disables rotation.

map.description: Default map to load on server startup.

mappath.description: Path (relative to base directory) where custom maps are stored.

maxclients.description: Maximum number of player slots (including spectators).

maxrate.description: Maximum network bandwidth per client (in bytes/sec). Adjust for dialup or high-latency clients.

minplayers.description: Minimum players required to start a match (0 = start anytime).

modelpath.description: Path (relative to base directory) where custom player models are stored.

net_port.description: UDP port for client connections (must match main 'port' unless using a proxy or relay).

port.description: Main UDP port for client connections. Standard for Quake III Arena-compatible servers.

rcon_address.description: IP address to bind RCON to. Use '0.0.0.0' for remote access (not recommended for security).

rcon_password.description: Password for remote console (RCON). Leave blank to disable RCON. Use strong passwords.

rcon_tcp_enabled.description: Enable TCP-based RCON. Use only with TLS/proxy for production.

roundlimit.description: Match round limit. 0 disables round-based ending.

soundpath.description: Path (relative to base directory) for custom sounds.

sv_pausable.description: Allow server pause in dedicated mode (only with -pause flag or RCON).

sv_unlag.description: Enable anti-lag compensation (unlag) for fair play.

sv_unlag_lagtime.description: Maximum time window (in seconds) for unlag prediction. Lower for low-latency networks.

teambalance.description: Automatically balance teams based on player counts.

timelimit.description: Match time limit in minutes. 0 means no time limit (frag-based only).

url.description: Server website URL shown in server browser. Include http(s):// prefix.

ca_cert_path.description: Path to the primary CA certificate (optional; often auto-resolved via cacert_dir).

ca_revocation_list_path.description: Path to the CA certificate revocation list (CRL); auto-resolved in most cases.

cacert_dir.description: Directory containing CA certificates for validation.

cleanup_interval_seconds.description: Interval (in seconds) between credential cleanup runs.

credential_lifetime_hours.description: Default credential lifetime in hours (max 168 = 7 days).

enable_gridftp.description: Enable optional GridFTP data channel support.

enforce_renewal.description: Enforce credential renewal within the threshold (deny access if expired).

gridftp_port.description: Base port for GridFTP data connections (if enabled).

identity_cert_path.description: Path to the server's X.509 certificate file.

identity_key_path.description: Path to the server's private key file.

listen_address.description: IP address the server binds to (e.g., '127.0.0.1' or '::' for IPv6).

listen_port.description: TCP port number for incoming MyProxy connections.

log_file.description: Path to the log file (empty string disables file logging).

log_level.description: Logging verbosity: 'debug', 'info', 'notice', 'warning', 'error', or 'critical'.

max_credentials_per_user.description: Maximum number of credentials a single user may store at once.

num_threads.description: Number of worker threads for handling concurrent requests.

renewal_threshold_hours.description: Minimum remaining lifetime (in hours) before credential renewal is required.

require_proxy_cert.description: Require clients to present a valid proxy certificate (not just end-entity cert).

working_dir.description: Directory for temporary files and credential storage.

daemon.description: Whether to run as a daemon.

log_file.description: Path to a log file; leave empty to log to syslog instead.

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging: 0=error, 1=warn, 2=info, 3=debug.

ssl_ca_path.description: Path to the SSL CA certificate file (used only if ssl_enabled is true).

ssl_cert_path.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file (used only if ssl_enabled is true).

ssl_enabled.description: Whether to enable SSL/TLS encryption for arbitrator-to-cluster communication.

ssl_key_path.description: Path to the SSL client private key file (used only if ssl_enabled is true).

vgroup.description: Name of the group (group) — must match the Galera cluster name.

basedir.description: Base directory where MariaDB is installed.

bind_address.description: IP address MariaDB binds to. Use '0.0.0.0' to accept connections from any interface (not recommended without firewall).

character_set_server.description: Default character set for new databases and tables.

collation_server.description: Default collation for new databases and tables. Must match character_set_server.

datadir.description: Directory where database files are stored.

innodb_buffer_pool_size.description: Size of the memory buffer InnoDB uses to cache data and indexes. Recommend ~70% of available RAM on dedicated servers.

innodb_file_per_table.description: Store each InnoDB table in its own .ibd file. Required for tablespace operations and compression.

innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit.description: Controls InnoDB durability vs performance trade-off. 1 = safest (sync on each commit), 2 = faster (sync once/sec), 0 = fastest (risk of data loss).

innodb_log_file_size.description: Size of each InnoDB log file in the log group. Larger values improve performance but increase crash recovery time.

log_bin_enabled.description: Enable binary logging. Required for replication and point-in-time recovery.

log_bin_trust_function_creators.description: If disabled (recommended), prevents users without SUPER p

long_query_time.description: Queries taking longer than this many seconds will be logged as slow queries.

max_allowed_packet.description: Maximum size of a single packet or any generated/intermediate BLOB.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

port.description: TCP/IP port number for client connections.

query_cache_size.description: Total memory allocated for query cache. Set to 0 to disable. Ignored if query_cache_type is OFF.

query_cache_type.description: Query cache behavior: 0=OFF, 1=ON (cache all except SELECT SQL_NO_CACHE), 2=DEMAND (cache only SELECT SQL_CACHE). Deprecated in MariaDB 10.1+.

server_id.description: Unique server identifier for replication. Must be unique across all servers in the replication topology.

slow_query_log_enabled.description: Enable logging of slow queries to file (or to table if log_output includes TABLE).

slow_query_log_file.description: Path to the slow query log file (only used if slow_query_log is enabled).

thread_cache_size.description: Number of threads to keep cached for reuse. Helps reduce thread creation overhead on high-concurrency workloads.

tmpdir.description: Directory for temporary files created by MariaDB (e.g., during sorting or temp tables).

host.description: The host to bind the NATS server to.

port.description: The port to listen on for client connections.

cni_conf_dir.description: Path to CNI network configuration directory.

debug_level.description: Log level for containerd (debug, info, warn, error, etc.).

default_runtime_name.description: Default container runtime to use for containers (e.g., 'runc', 'kata-runtime').

devmapper_pool_name.description: Device mapper pool name (if using devmapper snapshotter).

enable_cri.description: Enable the CRI plugin to support Kubernetes container runtime API.

grpc_address.description: Unix socket path for containerd gRPC API.

grpc_max_recv_message_size.description: Maximum gRPC receive message size in bytes.

grpc_max_send_message_size.description: Maximum gRPC send message size in bytes.

image_deletion.description: Enable automatic deletion of unused images (recommended in production).

image_pull_timeout.description: Timeout for image pull operations in seconds (0 = unlimited).

max_container_log_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of container stdout/stderr logs.

metrics_interval.description: Interval (seconds) between metric exports (set to 0 to disable).

no_pivot.description: Disable pivot root (not recommended for production — useful only in constrained environments).

overlayfs_native_diff.description: Use native diff algorithm for overlayfs snapshots (slower but accurate; fallback if 'diff' fails).

pprof_enabled.description: Enable pprof CPU/memory profiling endpoint (disabled by default).

privileged_without_host_devices.description: Grant privileges to containers without exposing host devices (Kubernetes-specific).

root_dir.description: Root directory for persistent containerd data (snapshots, image layers).

sandbox_image.description: Image used for Kubernetes sandbox (pause) containers.

snapshotter.description: Default snapshotter used for container filesystem layers (e.g., 'overlayfs', 'btrfs', 'devmapper').

state_dir.description: Directory for containerd runtime state (sockets, PID files, etc.).

ca_file.description: Path to the CA certificate file used to validate peer certificates.

cert_expiry.renew_days.description: Start automatic certificate renewal this many days before expiry.

cert_expiry.warn_days.description: Alert operator when certificate expires in fewer than this many days.

cert_file.description: Path to the TLS certificate file used to authenticate this node.

control.listen.description: Address for local control/mgmt API (e.g., health, metrics, push).

control_cert.ca_file.description: CA cert to validate control API clients.

control_cert.cert_file.description: TLS cert for control API (mTLS required).

firewall_default_inbound_action.description: Fallback action for unmatched inbound traffic.

firewall_default_outbound_action.description: Fallback action for unmatched outbound traffic.

ip.description: Public IP address of this host, visible to peers (optional; used for NAT traversal and lighthouse registration).

key_file.description: Path to the private key file corresponding to the certificate.

lighthouse.description: Whether this node should act as a lighthouse (participant in peer discovery).

listen_addr.description: IP address on which to listen for incoming Nebula connections.

log_file.description: Optional path to write logs to (stdout if empty).

log_level.description: Logging verbosity.

mtu.description: Maximum transmission unit (MTU) for the Nebula tunnel interface.

port.description: UDP port to listen on for Nebula traffic.

psk_file.description: Path to a file containing a per-connection pre-shared key (optional, adds an extra layer of encryption).

pulse.enabled.description: Enable pulse probing to check health of connected peers.

relays_enabled.description: If true, this node may act as a relay to forward traffic between peers behind symmetric NATs.

subnet.description: IPv4 CIDR subnet to assign to this node's Nebula interface (must match network-wide plan).

tun.dev.description: Name of the tun interface to create (Linux only).

drop_duplicates.description: Drop duplicate messages (same content from same source within duplicate_window).

duplicate_window.description: Time window (in seconds) to detect duplicate messages.

enable_ipv6.description: Enable listening on IPv6 (if supported by the system).

enable_rate_limit.description: Enable per-source rate limiting to protect against flooding.

enable_syslog.description: If true, log to syslog instead of a file.

interface.description: Network interface to bind to (e.g., eth0). Leave empty to bind to all interfaces.

listen_addr.description: IP address to bind the server to. Use 0.0.0.0 for all IPv4 interfaces, :: for all IPv6, or a specific address.

listen_port.description: UDP port to listen on for incoming NetStream/NetFlow/sFlow messages.

log_file.description: Path to the log file (used only if enable_syslog = false).

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level. Options: debug, info, warn, error, fatal.

max_message_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of an incoming message to accept. Larger messages are dropped.

output_dir.description: Directory where output files (e.g., plain logs) are written.

output_format.description: Format for output files. Options: json, plain, syslog.

persist_state.description: Persist duplicate cache and rate-limit state to disk across restarts.

pid_file.description: Path to the PID file for the netconsd process.

rate_limit_burst.description: Maximum burst size (messages) before rate limiting kicks in.

rate_limit_max.description: Maximum messages per second allowed per source IP (0 = no limit).

state_file.description: Path to the state file (used only if persist_state = true).

workers.description: Number of worker threads for message processing.

cni_conf_dir.description: Path to CNI network configuration directory.

debug_level.description: Log level for containerd (debug, info, warn, error, etc.).

default_runtime_name.description: Default container runtime to use for containers (e.g., 'runc', 'kata-runtime').

devmapper_pool_name.description: Device mapper pool name (if using devmapper snapshotter).

enable_cri.description: Enable the CRI plugin to support Kubernetes container runtime API.

grpc_address.description: Unix socket path for containerd gRPC API.

grpc_max_recv_message_size.description: Maximum gRPC receive message size in bytes.

grpc_max_send_message_size.description: Maximum gRPC send message size in bytes.

image_deletion.description: Enable automatic deletion of unused images (recommended in production).

image_pull_timeout.description: Timeout for image pull operations in seconds (0 = unlimited).

max_container_log_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of container stdout/stderr logs.

metrics_interval.description: Interval (seconds) between metric exports (set to 0 to disable).

no_pivot.description: Disable pivot root (not recommended for production — useful only in constrained environments).

overlayfs_native_diff.description: Use native diff algorithm for overlayfs snapshots (slower but accurate; fallback if 'diff' fails).

pprof_enabled.description: Enable pprof CPU/memory profiling endpoint (disabled by default).

privileged_without_host_devices.description: Grant privileges to containers without exposing host devices (Kubernetes-specific).

root_dir.description: Root directory for persistent containerd data (snapshots, image layers).

sandbox_image.description: Image used for Kubernetes sandbox (pause) containers.

snapshotter.description: Default snapshotter used for container filesystem layers (e.g., 'overlayfs', 'btrfs', 'devmapper').

state_dir.description: Directory for containerd runtime state (sockets, PID files, etc.).

api_workers.description: Number of worker processes for the DHCP agent API server. Set to 0 to disable the API server.

bind_host.description: IP address to bind the DHCP agent API server to. Use 0.0.0.0 to listen on all interfaces.

broadcast_in_dns.description: Include broadcast address in DHCP responses as option 28.

classless_route_in_dns.description: Include classless static routes (option 121) — modern replacement for option 33.

dhcp_broadcast.description: Enable DHCP broadcast replies. Set to false for unicast-only environments (e.g., some cloud environments).

dhcp_driver.description: DHCP driver class to use for managing DHCP services (e.g., dnsmasq).

dhcp_leasefile.description: Path to the shared dnsmasq leases file used for tracking DHCP assignments.

dhcp_leasefs.description: Base directory for DHCP lease files managed by the agent.

dnsmasq_config_dir.description: Directory containing per-network dnsmasq configuration files. Allows per-subnet customization.

domain.description: DNS domain to assign to instances (e.g., openstack.local). Used for hostname resolution inside VMs.

domain_in_dns.description: Include domain name in DHCP responses as option 15.

enable_dnsmasq_cache.description: Enable DNS query caching in dnsmasq. Improves DNS resolution performance for repeated lookups.

enable_dnsmasq_dns.description: Enable DNS functionality in dnsmasq for instances. Disabling may break name resolution in VMs.

enable_isolated_metadata.description: Enable metadata proxy for isolated networks (e.g., tenant networks without routers). Required for instance metadata access in such cases.

enable_metadata_proxy.description: Enable metadata proxy on shared networks. Allows instances to access the Neutron metadata service via a proxy.

firmware_in_dns.description: Include firmware version (option 93) — for PXE boot device firmware info.

gateway_in_dns.description: Include gateway (router) IP in DHCP responses as option 3.

heartbeat_interval.description: Seconds between heartbeat messages sent to the Neutron server. Set to 0 to disable heartbeats (not recommended).

host_routes_in_dns.description: Include host routes in DHCP responses as option 121 (classless static routes).

initfile_in_dns.description: Include init file name (option 50) — used for some bootloaders.

lease_time.description: Default DHCP lease time in seconds (e.g., 86400 for 24 hours).

location_in_dns.description: Include location option (option 112) — for geolocation or rack-aware provisioning.

log_dir.description: Directory where log files are stored for the DHCP agent.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level for the DHCP agent.

maxdhcpdevices.description: Maximum number of DHCP agents that can serve a given network. Increases fault tolerance but adds overhead.

metadata_port.description: Port used by the metadata proxy to forward instance requests to the Neutron metadata service.

mtu_in_dns.description: Include interface MTU in DHCP responses as option 26. Requires dnsmasq >= 2.67.

mtu_set.description: Enable --mtu-set in dnsmasq. Requires dnsmasq >= 2.67. Sets the interface MTU via DHCP.

netboot_in_dns.description: Include netboot option (option 209) — for iPXE/HTTP boot support.

ntp_servers_in_dns.description: Include NTP server IPs in DHCP responses as option 42.

pxeserver_in_dns.description: Include PXE server option (option 66/67) — for legacy PXE boot servers.

rootpath_in_dns.description: Include root path (option 17) — for diskless boot.

router_in_dns.description: Alias for gateway_in_dns (include router as option 3).

static_routes_in_dns.description: Include static routes in DHCP responses as option 121 (alias of host_routes_in_dns).

subnet_mask_in_dns.description: Include subnet mask in DHCP responses as option 1.

tftp_in_dns.description: Include TFTP server option — used for network boot.

use_external_dhcp.description: Use external DHCP servers instead of Neutron-managed dnsmasq for certain networks (e.g., provider networks).

user_class_in_dns.description: Include user class identifier (option 77) — for client-side classification.

vendor_class_in_dns.description: Include vendor class identifier (option 60) — used for PXE boot device identification.

debug.description: Enable debug logging for detailed diagnostics.

enabled.description: Enable the BGP Dynamic Routing Agent service.

log_dir.description: Directory where BGP agent logs are written.

log_file.description: Optional log filename. If omitted, logs go to stdout.

state_path.description: Directory for runtime files such as PID and lock files.

transport_url.description: Message broker transport URL (e.g., RabbitMQ or other RPC backend).

agent_id.description: Unique identifier for this L3 agent instance (must be unique across all agents in the deployment).

debug.description: Enable verbose debugging output for troubleshooting.

enable_dhcp.description: Enable DHCP agent functionality within the L3 agent process.

enable_ipv6.description: Enable IPv6 router advertisements and ND support.

enable_nat.description: Enable NAT for internal-to-external network translation (required for floating IPs and SNAT).

external_network_bridge.description: Bridge name used for external network traffic. Empty string uses the default bridge (e.g., br-ex).

gateway_external_device.description: Physical interface (e.g., 'eth0') bound to gateway router. Required for SNAT/DNAT when not using OVS.

ha.description: Enable high availability (HA) for routers using keepalived. Requires shared storage or database replication.

ha_network_mtu.description: MTU (in bytes) for the HA network interface. Should account for overhead (e.g., 1500 - 50 for VXLAN).

ha_network_name.description: Name of the Neutron network used for HA heartbeat traffic when HA mode is enabled.

interface_driver.description: The driver to use for managing the external interface (e.g., 'linuxbridge', 'openvswitch').

log_file.description: Path to the log file for the L3 agent. Empty string logs to stdout.

max_routers_per_agent.description: Maximum number of routers this agent will manage. Set to 0 for unlimited. Helps distribute load across agents.

min_restart_interval.description: Minimum time (in seconds) between agent restarts. Prevents thrashing during rapid failures.

num_router_agents.description: Number of parallel worker processes for router processing. Increase under high router load.

ovs_integration_bridge.description: Name of the Open vSwitch integration bridge.

report_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between agent heartbeats to the Neutron server. Shorter intervals improve failover detection.

state_sync_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between state syncs with the Neutron server. Lower values improve responsiveness but increase load.

bridge_mapping.description: Legacy alias for physical_interface_mappings — prefer physical_mappings. Format: 'physnet1:br-eth0'.

dhcp_broadcast.description: Enable suppression of broadcast DHCP traffic between ports on the same network (improves security).

enable_dhcp_notification.description: Enable DHCP agent notifications for HA DHCP (used when multiple DHCP agents are coordinated).

enable_hairpin.description: Enable hairpinning: allow VMs to reach themselves via floating IPs through the router.

enable_metadata_proxy.description: Enable the metadata proxy service (required for instance metadata access via Neutron metadata service).

enable_security_group.description: Enable security groups (iptables or nftables firewall rules for VMs). Required for tenant isolation.

enable_vxlan.description: Enable VXLAN as the overlay network type (requires underlying L2 reachability or unicast/multicast support).

firewall_driver.description: Firewall driver implementation. Common values: iptables (default), nftables, or noop (disabled).

linux_bridge_path.description: Path to the Linux bridge utilities (for legacy compatibility).

local_ip.description: Local IP address of the node’s overlay network interface. Required for unicast VXLAN (when no multicast is available).

log_dir.description: Directory where log files will be stored.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level. Options: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL.

max_retry_interval.description: Maximum seconds to wait between retry attempts (exponential backoff cap).

metadata_proxy_shared_secret.description: Shared secret (string) used to authenticate metadata proxy requests to the Neutron metadata service. Should match neutron.conf.

min_retry_interval.description: Minimum seconds to wait between failed device creation/retry attempts.

multicast_group.description: Multicast group address (e.g., '239.1.1.1') for VXLAN broadcast replication in multicast mode. Required only if enable_vxlan and using multicast.

polling_interval.description: Number of seconds between device polling loops (e.g., to detect port changes). Lower = more responsive but higher CPU.

port_security.description: Enable port security extension — prevents MAC/IP spoofing by enforcing allowed address pairs.

virtual_interface_type.description: Type of virtual interface to use for guest VMs. Supported: 'veth', 'macvtap', 'bridge' (legacy).

vxlan_udp_port.description: UDP port to use for VXLAN overlay traffic. Standard is 4789 (RFC 7348).

cafile.description: Path to CA certificate bundle for SSL verification (optional).

debug.description: Enable debug logging (implies verbose).

enable_isolated_metadata.description: Enable metadata service for isolated networks (e.g., without floating IPs).

insecure.description: Disable SSL certificate verification (not recommended in production).

isolated_metadata_hostname.description: Custom hostname for isolated metadata (fallback if not provided by DHCP).

isolated_metadata_ip.description: Custom IP for isolated metadata (fallback if not provided by DHCP).

log_dir.description: Directory where log files are stored.

domain.description: PTP domain number (0–127). If omitted, defaults to 0. Corresponds to -n in phc2sys.

first_step_threshold.description: Step threshold applied only on the first update (20µs by default). Not currently in schema — added as required by docs.

kernel_leap.description: If true, let the kernel apply leap seconds (default). If false, let phc2sys correct the one-second offset via frequency adjustment (unless step_threshold applies). Maps to -x (no value).

ntpshm_segment.description: SHM segment number for ntpshm servo. Default 0.

offset_samples.description: Number of PHC readings per sink update. Only the fastest reading is used. Default is 5. Previously named 'offset_samples' — preserved, maps to -N.

phc_device.description: Path to the PHC device (e.g., '/dev/ptp0'). When provided, overrides automatic detection. Corresponds to -s (source device) in manual mode.

phc_timestamping.description: Deprecated. phc2sys does not have a -T option for timestamping mode. This directive was hallucinated.

pi_integral_const.description: Integral constant for PI servo. Default 0.3.

pi_proportional_const.description: Proportional constant for PI servo. Default 0.7.

slave_only.description: Deprecated. phc2sys has no -S flag (it exists but is for step_threshold, not slave mode). Use ptp4l for slave-only behavior.

source_clock.description: Source clock — device path (e.g., '/dev/ptp0'), interface (e.g., 'eth0'), or name (e.g., 'CLOCK_REALTIME'). Required for manual mode.

step_threshold.description: Maximum offset (seconds) before a clock step is allowed. The clock is stepped on start regardless if offset > 20µs unless -F (first_step_threshold) is used. Default is 0.0 (disabled stepping after start).

test_mode.description: If true, run in test mode — compute offsets but do not adjust the clock. Maps to -n domain-number, but due to conflict, template uses -n only when domain is set. To avoid conflict, test_mode should be handled separately or removed. Per manpage, -n has no test-mode function — only domain-number. Thus test_mode is unsupported and should be removed or reinterpreted. For clarity, set default false and note limitation.

transport.description: Deprecated. phc2sys does not accept -x for transport type. That flag exists but controls leap second handling, not transport.

update_rate.description: Sink update rate (per second) in direct mode. Default is 1. Maps to -R.
