clientSendBuf.description: Specifies the desired size of the buffer to use when sending SNMP requests.

clientaddr.description: Specifies the source address to be used by command-line applications when sending SNMP requests.

clientaddrUsesPort.description: Specifies whether a port number in clientaddr should be used for outgoing requests (IPv4 only).

commentToEOL.description: Whether MIB parsing should accept comments extending to the end of the line.

debugLogLevel.description: Set the priority level for logging of debug output.

debugTokens.description: Defines the debugging tokens to be turned on when doDebugging is set.

defAuthLocalizedKey.description: Defines the (hexadecimal) localized key for authentication in SNMPv3.

defAuthMasterKey.description: Defines the (hexadecimal) master key for authentication in SNMPv3.

defAuthPassphrase.description: Defines the default authentication passphrase to use for SNMPv3 requests.

defAuthType.description: Defines the default authentication protocol to use for SNMPv3 requests.

defCommunity.description: Defines the default community to use for SNMPv1 and SNMPv2c requests.

defContext.description: Defines the default context to use for SNMPv3 requests.

defDomain.description: The transport domain that should be used for a certain application type unless something else is specified.

defPassphrase.description: Defines the default authentication and privacy passphrases to use for SNMPv3 requests.

defPrivLocalizedKey.description: Defines the (hexadecimal) localized key for privacy in SNMPv3.

defPrivMasterKey.description: Defines the (hexadecimal) master key for privacy in SNMPv3.

defPrivPassphrase.description: Defines the default privacy passphrase to use for SNMPv3 requests.

defPrivType.description: Defines the default privacy protocol to use for SNMPv3 requests.

defSecurityLevel.description: Defines the default security level to use for SNMPv3 requests.

defSecurityModel.description: Defines the security model to use for SNMPv3 requests.

defSecurityName.description: Defines the default security name to use for SNMPv3 requests.

defTarget.description: The target that should be used for connections to a certain application if the connection should be in a specific domain.

defVersion.description: Defines the default version of SNMP to use.

defaultPort.description: Defines the default UDP port that client SNMP applications will attempt to connect to.

doDebugging.description: Turns on debugging for all applications if set to 1.

dontLoadHostConfig.description: Specifies whether or not the host-specific configuration files are loaded.

dumpPacket.description: Defines whether to display a hexadecimal dump of raw SNMP requests sent and received.

hexOutputLength.description: Specifies where to break up the output of hexadecimal strings.

logTimestamp.description: Whether commands should log timestamps with their error/message logging.

mibAllowUnderline.description: Whether to allow underline characters in MIB object names and enumeration values.

mibWarningLevel.description: The minimum warning level of the warnings printed by the MIB parser.

mibdirs.description: Specifies a list of directories to search for MIB files.

mibfile.description: Specifies a single MIB file to load in addition to those from mibs token.

mibs.description: Specifies a list of MIB modules that should be loaded.

noDisplayHint.description: Disables use of DISPLAY-HINT information when parsing indices and values to set.

noPersistentLoad.description: Disables loading of persistent configuration information.

noPersistentSave.description: Disables saving of persistent configuration information.

noRangeCheck.description: Disables validation of varbind values against the MIB definition.

noTokenWarnings.description: Disables warnings about unknown config file tokens.

outputPrecision.description: Uses the PRECISION string to modify value output format (equivalent to -Op).

persistentDir.description: Defines the directory where snmpd and snmptrapd store persistent configuration settings.

retries.description: Specifies the number of retries to be used in the requests.

reverseEncodeBER.description: Controls how the encoding of SNMP requests is handled.

serverRecvBuf.description: Specifies the desired size of the buffer to use when receiving incoming SNMP requests.

serverSendBuf.description: Specifies the desired size of the buffer to use when sending SNMP responses.

showMibErrors.description: Whether to display MIB parsing errors.

sourceFilterAddress.description: Specifies an address to be added to the source address filter list.

sourceFilterType.description: Specifies whether addresses in sourceFilterAddress are accepted or blocked.

sshprivkey.description: Set the private key file to use when connecting to a remote system.

sshpubkey.description: Set the public key file to use when connecting to a remote system.

sshtosnmpsocket.description: Sets the path of the sshtosnmp socket for incoming SSH connections.

sshtosnmpsocketperms.description: Sets the mode, owner and group of the sshtosnmp socket.

sshusername.description: Sets the SSH user name for logging into the remote system.

suffixPrinting.description: The value 1 is equivalent to -Os and 2 is equivalent to -OS.

tempFilePattern.description: Defines a filename template for creating temporary files.

timeout.description: Specifies the timeout in seconds between retries.

transport.description: Special token in host-specific config files to specify destination transport and address.

AddKeysToAgent.description: Specifies whether keys should be automatically added to a running ssh-agent.

AddressFamily.description: Specifies which address family to use when connecting.

BatchMode.description: If set to yes, disables user interaction such as password prompts and host key confirmation.

BindAddress.description: Use the specified address on the local machine as the source address of the connection.

BindInterface.description: Use the address of the specified interface on the local machine as the source address of the connection.

CASignatureAlgorithms.description: Specifies which algorithms are allowed for signing of certificates by CAs.

CanonicalDomains.description: When CanonicalizeHostname is enabled, specifies the list of domain suffixes to search.

CanonicalizeFallbackLocal.description: Specifies whether to fail with an error when hostname canonicalization fails.

CanonicalizeHostname.description: Controls whether explicit hostname canonicalization is performed.

CanonicalizeMaxDots.description: Specifies the maximum number of dot characters in a hostname before canonicalization is disabled.

CanonicalizePermittedCNAMEs.description: Specifies rules to determine whether CNAMEs should be followed during hostname canonicalization.

CertificateFile.description: Specifies a file from which the user's certificate is read.

ChannelTimeout.description: Specifies timeouts for inactive channels in type=interval format.

CheckHostIP.description: If set to yes, ssh will check the host IP address in known_hosts file.

Ciphers.description: Specifies the ciphers allowed and their order of preference.

ClearAllForwardings.description: Clears all local, remote, and dynamic port forwardings.

ConnectTimeout.description: Specifies the timeout in seconds used when connecting to the SSH server.

ConnectionAttempts.description: Specifies the number of connection tries (one per second) before exiting.

ControlMaster.description: Enables sharing of multiple sessions over a single network connection.

ControlPath.description: Specify the path to the control socket used for connection sharing.

ControlPersist.description: When used with ControlMaster, specifies how long the master connection should remain open in background.

DynamicForward.description: Specifies that a TCP port on the local machine be forwarded over the secure channel.

EnableEscapeCommandline.description: Enables the command line option in the EscapeChar menu for interactive sessions.

EnableSSHKeysign.description: Enables the use of ssh-keysign(8) during HostbasedAuthentication.

ExitOnForwardFailure.description: Specifies whether ssh should terminate if port forwardings cannot be set up.

FingerprintHash.description: Specifies the hash algorithm used when displaying key fingerprints.

ForkAfterAuthentication.description: Requests ssh to go to background just before command execution.

ForwardAgent.description: Specifies whether the connection to the authentication agent will be forwarded.

ForwardX11.description: Specifies whether X11 connections will be automatically redirected.

ForwardX11Timeout.description: Specify a timeout for untrusted X11 forwarding.

ForwardX11Trusted.description: If set to yes, remote X11 clients will have full access to the original X11 display.

GSSAPIAuthentication.description: Specifies whether user authentication based on GSSAPI is allowed.

GSSAPIClientIdentity.description: Specifies the GSSAPI client identity to use.

GSSAPIKexAlgorithms.description: The list of key exchange algorithms offered for GSSAPI key exchange.

GSSAPIKeyExchange.description: Specifies whether key exchange based on GSSAPI may be used.

GSSAPIRenewalForcesRekey.description: If set to yes, renewal of GSSAPI credentials forces rekeying of the SSH connection.

GSSAPIServerIdentity.description: Specifies the GSSAPI server identity to expect.

GSSAPITrustDns.description: Set to yes to indicate that the DNS is trusted to securely canonicalize the host name.

GatewayPorts.description: Specifies whether remote hosts are allowed to connect to local forwarded ports.

GlobalKnownHostsFile.description: Specifies one or more files to use for the global host key database.

HashKnownHosts.description: Indicates that ssh should hash host names and addresses in known_hosts.

HostKeyAlgorithms.description: Specifies the host key signature algorithms that the client wants to use in order of preference.

HostKeyAlias.description: Specifies an alias for the real host name when looking up or saving host keys.

HostbasedAcceptedAlgorithms.description: Specifies the signature algorithms that will be used for hostbased authentication.

HostbasedAuthentication.description: Specifies whether to try rhosts based authentication with public key authentication.

Hostname.description: Specifies the real host name to log into.

IPQoS.description: Specifies the IPv4 type-of-service or DSCP class for connections.

IdentitiesOnly.description: Specifies that ssh should only use the configured authentication identity and certificate files.

IdentityAgent.description: Specifies the Unix-domain socket used to communicate with the authentication agent.

IdentityFile.description: Specifies a file from which the user's authentication identity is read.

IgnoreUnknown.description: Specifies a pattern-list of unknown options to be ignored during config parsing.

KbdInteractiveAuthentication.description: Specifies whether to use keyboard-interactive authentication.

KbdInteractiveDevices.description: Specifies the list of methods to use in keyboard-interactive authentication.

KexAlgorithms.description: Specifies the available KEX (Key Exchange) algorithms.

KnownHostsCommand.description: Specifies a command to use to obtain a list of host keys.

LocalCommand.description: Specifies a command to execute on the local machine after connecting to the server.

LocalForward.description: Specifies that a TCP port on the local machine be forwarded to the remote host.

LogLevel.description: Gives the verbosity level used when logging messages from ssh.

LogVerbose.description: Specify one or more overrides to LogLevel for debugging.

MACs.description: Specifies the MAC algorithms in order of preference.

NoHostAuthenticationForLocalhost.description: Disable host authentication for localhost (loopback addresses).

NumberOfPasswordPrompts.description: Specifies the number of password prompts before giving up.

ObscureKeystrokeTiming.description: Specifies whether to obscure inter-keystroke timings from passive observers.

PKCS11Provider.description: Specifies which PKCS#11 provider to use.

PasswordAuthentication.description: Specifies whether to use password authentication.

PermitLocalCommand.description: Allow local command execution via LocalCommand or escape sequence.

PermitRemoteOpen.description: Specifies destinations to which remote TCP port forwarding is permitted.

Port.description: Specifies the port number to connect on the remote host.

PreferredAuthentications.description: Specifies the order in which the client should try authentication methods.

ProxyCommand.description: Specifies the command to use to connect to the server.

ProxyJump.description: Specifies one or more jump proxies for the connection.

ProxyUseFdpass.description: Specifies that ProxyCommand will pass a connected file descriptor back to ssh.

PubkeyAcceptedAlgorithms.description: Specifies the signature algorithms that will be used for public key authentication.

PubkeyAuthentication.description: Specifies whether to try public key authentication.

RekeyLimit.description: Specifies maximum amount of data before session key renegotiation, optionally followed by a time limit.

RemoteCommand.description: Specifies a command to execute on the remote machine after connecting.

RemoteForward.description: Specifies that a TCP port on the remote machine be forwarded over the secure channel.

AcceptEnv.description: Specifies what environment variables sent by the client will be copied into the session's environ(7).

AddressFamily.description: Specifies which address family should be used by sshd(8).

AllowAgentForwarding.description: Specifies whether ssh-agent(1) forwarding is permitted.

AllowGroups.description: Login allowed only for users whose primary group or supplementary group list matches one of the patterns.

AllowStreamLocalForwarding.description: Specifies whether StreamLocal (Unix-domain socket) forwarding is permitted.

AllowTcpForwarding.description: Specifies whether TCP forwarding is permitted.

AllowUsers.description: Login allowed only for user names that match one of the patterns.

AuthenticationMethods.description: Specifies the authentication methods that must be successfully completed for a user to be granted access.

AuthorizedKeysCommand.description: Specifies a program to be used to look up the user's public keys.

AuthorizedKeysCommandUser.description: Specifies the user under whose account the AuthorizedKeysCommand is run.

AuthorizedKeysFile.description: Specifies the file that contains the public keys used for user authentication.

AuthorizedPrincipalsCommand.description: Specifies a program to be used to generate the list of allowed certificate principals.

AuthorizedPrincipalsCommandUser.description: Specifies the user under whose account the AuthorizedPrincipalsCommand is run.

AuthorizedPrincipalsFile.description: Specifies a file that lists principal names accepted for certificate authentication.

Banner.description: The contents of the specified file are sent to the remote user before authentication is allowed.

CASignatureAlgorithms.description: Specifies which algorithms are allowed for signing of certificates by certificate authorities (CAs).

ChannelTimeout.description: Specifies whether and how quickly sshd(8) should close inactive channels.

ChrootDirectory.description: Specifies the pathname of a directory to chroot(2) to after authentication.

ClientAliveCountMax.description: Sets the number of client alive messages which may be sent without sshd(8) receiving any messages back from the client.

ClientAliveInterval.description: Sets a timeout interval in seconds after which if no data has been received from the client, sshd(8) will send a message through the encrypted channel to request a response from the client.

Compression.description: Specifies whether compression is enabled after the user has authenticated successfully.

DebianBanner.description: Specifies whether the distribution-specified extra version suffix is included during initial protocol handshake.

DenyGroups.description: Login is disallowed for users whose primary group or supplementary group list matches one of the patterns.

DenyUsers.description: Login is disallowed for user names that match one of the patterns.

DisableForwarding.description: Disables all forwarding features, including X11, ssh-agent(1), TCP and StreamLocal.

ExposeAuthInfo.description: Writes a temporary file containing a list of authentication methods and public credentials used to authenticate the user.

FingerprintHash.description: Specifies the hash algorithm used when logging key fingerprints.

ForceCommand.description: Forces the execution of the command specified by ForceCommand, ignoring any command supplied by the client.

GSSAPIAuthentication.description: Specifies whether user authentication based on GSSAPI is allowed.

GSSAPICleanupCredentials.description: Specifies whether to automatically destroy the user's credentials cache on logout.

GSSAPIKexAlgorithms.description: The list of key exchange algorithms that are accepted by GSSAPI key exchange.

GSSAPIKeyExchange.description: Specifies whether key exchange based on GSSAPI is allowed.

GSSAPIStoreCredentialsOnRekey.description: Controls whether the user's GSSAPI credentials should be updated following a successful connection rekeying.

GSSAPIStrictAcceptorCheck.description: Determines whether to be strict about the identity of the GSSAPI acceptor a client authenticates against.

GatewayPorts.description: Specifies whether remote hosts are allowed to connect to ports forwarded for the client.

HostCertificate.description: Specifies a file containing a public host certificate.

HostKey.description: Specifies a file containing a private host key used by SSH.

HostKeyAgent.description: Identifies the UNIX-domain socket used to communicate with an agent that has access to the private host keys.

HostKeyAlgorithms.description: Specifies the host key signature algorithms that the server offers.

HostbasedAcceptedAlgorithms.description: Specifies the signature algorithms that will be accepted for hostbased authentication.

HostbasedAuthentication.description: Specifies whether rhosts or /etc/hosts.equiv authentication together with successful public key client host authentication is allowed.

HostbasedUsesNameFromPacketOnly.description: Specifies whether or not the server will attempt to perform a reverse name lookup when matching the name in the ~/.shosts, ~/.rhosts, and /etc/hosts.equiv files during HostbasedAuthentication.

IPQoS.default: lowdelay for interactive, throughput for non-interactive
IPQoS.description: Specifies the IPv4 type-of-service or DSCP class for the connection.

IgnoreRhosts.description: Specifies whether to ignore per-user .rhosts and .shosts files during HostbasedAuthentication.

IgnoreUserKnownHosts.description: Specifies whether sshd(8) should ignore the user's ~/.ssh/known_hosts during HostbasedAuthentication.

KbdInteractiveAuthentication.description: Specifies whether to allow keyboard-interactive authentication.

KerberosAuthentication.description: Specifies whether the password provided by the user for PasswordAuthentication will be validated through the Kerberos KDC.

KerberosGetAFSToken.description: If AFS is active and the user has a Kerberos 5 TGT, attempt to acquire an AFS token before accessing the user's home directory.

KerberosOrLocalPasswd.description: If password authentication through Kerberos fails then the password will be validated via any additional local mechanism such as /etc/passwd.

KerberosTicketCleanup.description: Specifies whether to automatically destroy the user's ticket cache file on logout.

KexAlgorithms.description: Specifies the available KEX (Key Exchange) algorithms.

ListenAddress.description: Specifies the local addresses sshd(8) should listen on.

LogLevel.description: Gives the verbosity level that is used when logging messages from sshd(8).

LogVerbose.description: Specify one or more overrides to LogLevel.

LoginGraceTime.description: The server disconnects after this time if the user has not successfully logged in.

MACs.description: Specifies the available MAC (message authentication code) algorithms.

MaxAuthTries.description: Specifies the maximum number of authentication attempts permitted per connection.

MaxSessions.description: Specifies the maximum number of open shell, login or subsystem sessions permitted per network connection.

MaxStartups.description: Specifies the maximum number of concurrent unauthenticated connections to the SSH daemon.

ModuliFile.description: Specifies the moduli(5) file that contains the Diffie-Hellman groups used for key exchange methods.

PasswordAuthentication.description: Specifies whether password authentication is allowed.

PerSourceMaxStartups.description: Specifies the number of unauthenticated connections allowed from a given source address.

PermitEmptyPasswords.description: When password authentication is allowed, specifies whether the server allows login to accounts with empty password strings.

PermitListen.description: Specifies the addresses/ports on which a remote TCP port forwarding may listen.

PermitOpen.description: Specifies the destinations to which TCP port forwarding is permitted.

PermitRootLogin.description: Specifies whether root can log in using ssh(1).

PermitTTY.description: Specifies whether pty(4) allocation is permitted.

PermitTunnel.description: Specifies whether tun(4) device forwarding is allowed.

PermitUserEnvironment.description: Specifies whether ~/.ssh/environment and environment= options in ~/.ssh/authorized_keys are processed by sshd(8).

PermitUserRC.description: Specifies whether any ~/.ssh/rc file is executed.

PidFile.description: Specifies the file that contains the process ID of the SSH daemon.

Port.description: Specifies the port number that sshd(8) listens on.

PrintLastLog.description: Specifies whether sshd(8) should print the date and time of the last user login when a user logs in interactively.

PrintMotd.description: Specifies whether sshd(8) should print /etc/motd when a user logs in interactively.

PubkeyAcceptedAlgorithms.description: Specifies the signature algorithms that will be accepted for public key authentication.

PubkeyAuthOptions.description: Sets one or more public key authentication options.

PubkeyAuthentication.description: Specifies whether public key authentication is allowed.

RekeyLimit.description: Specifies the maximum amount of data that may be transmitted or received before the session key is renegotiated.

RequiredRSASize.description: Specifies the minimum RSA key size (in bits) that sshd(8) will accept. Note that this limit may only be raised from the default.

RevokedKeys.description: Specifies revoked public keys file, or none to not use one.

SecurityKeyProvider.description: Specifies a path to a library that will be used when loading FIDO authenticator-hosted keys.

SetEnv.description: Specifies one or more environment variables to set in child sessions started by sshd(8).

StreamLocalBindUnlink.description: Specifies whether to remove an existing Unix-domain socket file for local or remote port forwarding before creating a new one.

StrictModes.description: Specifies whether sshd(8) should check file modes and ownership of the user's files and home directory before accepting login.

Subsystem.description: Configures an external subsystem (e.g. file transfer daemon).

TCPKeepAlive.description: Specifies whether TCP keepalive messages will be sent to the client.

TrustedUserCAKeys.description: Specifies a file containing public keys of certificate authorities trusted for user authentication.

UnusedConnectionTimeout.description: Specifies whether and how quickly sshd(8) should close unused SSH connections.

UseDNS.description: Specifies whether sshd(8) should look up the remote host name and check that the resolved host name for the remote IP address maps back to the very same IP address.

X11DisplayOffset.description: Specifies the first display number available for sshd(8)'s X11 forwarding.

modules_load_preference.description: Specifies when to load plugins: on startup or on demand via D-Bus.

backup_initramfs.description: If set to yes, keeps a .bak backup of the previous initramfs.

update_initramfs.description: Controls whether initramfs updates are performed: yes (latest only), no (disabled), or all (all known initramfs).

PRUNEFS.description: Whitespace-separated list of file system types to skip during scanning.

PRUNENAMES.description: Whitespace-separated list of directory names to skip during scanning.

PRUNEPATHS.description: Whitespace-separated list of directory paths to skip during scanning.

PRUNE_BIND_MOUNTS.description: Whether to skip bind mounts (1/yes to skip).

enabled.description: When set to False, xdg-user-dirs-update will not change the XDG user dirs configuration.

filename_encoding.description: Sets the filename encoding to use (e.g., UTF-8 or locale).

DESKTOP.description: Default path for the Desktop directory, relative to the home directory.

DOCUMENTS.description: Default path for the Documents directory, relative to the home directory.

DOWNLOAD.description: Default path for the Downloads directory, relative to the home directory.

MUSIC.description: Default path for the Music directory, relative to the home directory.

PICTURES.description: Default path for the Pictures directory, relative to the home directory.

PUBLICSHARE.description: Default path for the Public share directory, relative to the home directory.

TEMPLATES.description: Default path for the Templates directory, relative to the home directory.

VIDEOS.description: Default path for the Videos directory, relative to the home directory.

comment.description: Comment or note about this user.

enabled.description: Whether this user is enabled or disabled.

allow_ssl.description: Allow SSL/TLS but do not require it (plaintext allowed if client declines TLS).

anon_max_rate.description: Max upload rate in bytes/sec for anonymous users (0 = unlimited).

anon_root.description: Directory to serve as root for anonymous users. Must exist and be owned by 'ftp'.

anon_umask.description: Umask for anonymous uploads (e.g., '077' → files 600, dirs 700 for security).

anon_upload_dir.description: Directory for anonymous uploads. Required for anon_upload_enable to take effect. Must be writable by the 'ftp' user.

anon_upload_enable.description: Allow anonymous users to upload files. Requires write_enable and proper directory permissions.

anonymous_enable.description: Allow anonymous FTP logins. Only enable if public file sharing is needed.

ascii_mode_upload.description: Enable ASCII mode uploads (auto-convert line endings).

banner_file.description: Path to file containing banner message (overrides ftpd_banner if set).

chroot_list_enable.description: Enable chroot exception list (users listed in chroot_list_file are exempt from chrooting).

chroot_list_file.description: Path to file containing users who should *not* be chrooted (if chroot_local_user=YES).

chroot_local_user.description: Chroot local users to their home directories for security. Prevents filesystem escape.

data_connection_timeout.description: Timeout for idle data connections (in seconds).

ftpd_banner.description: Banner displayed on initial FTP connection (e.g., welcome message).

guest_enable.description: Enable virtual users (requires PAM config mapping virtual users to system users).

guest_username.description: System user to map virtual users to (must exist).

hide_ids.description: Hide local user/group names in directory listings (shows numeric IDs instead).

listen.description: Run vsftpd in standalone mode (listening directly on ports).

listen_address.description: IP address to bind to (empty = all interfaces). Leave blank unless binding to specific interface.

listen_ipv6.description: Listen on IPv6 instead of IPv4 (if listen=YES and listen_ipv6=YES).

listen_port.description: FTP control port. Standard FTP uses 21.

local_enable.description: Allow local system users to log in via FTP.

local_max_rate.description: Max upload rate in bytes/sec for local users (0 = unlimited).

local_root.description: Root directory for local users after login. Use '$USER' for per-user home-based isolation.

local_umask.description: Umask for local users' uploaded files (e.g., '022' → files 644, dirs 755).

log_file.description: Alternate log file path (used when xferlog_std_format=NO).

max_clients.description: Maximum number of simultaneous clients. Set to 0 for unlimited.

max_per_ip.description: Maximum clients allowed per IP address.

pam_service_name.description: Name of PAM service for authentication (must match file in /etc/pam.d/).

pasv_enable.description: Enable passive FTP mode (required for clients behind NAT/firewalls).

pasv_max_port.description: Maximum port in the passive port range. Must be ≥ pasv_min_port. 0 = any port.

pasv_min_port.description: Minimum port in the passive port range. Ensure firewall allows this range. 0 = any port.

require_ssl.description: Require SSL/TLS for data connections (force encrypted file transfers).

rsa_private_key_file.description: Path to SSL private key (PEM format). If not set, the private key is expected to be in the same file as the certificate.

ssl_ciphers.description: Cipher suites to permit. Restrict to strong ciphers (e.g., AES-GCM, ChaCha20).

ssl_enable.description: Enable FTP over SSL/TLS (FTPS). Strongly recommended for production.

ssl_protocols.description: SSL/TLS protocols to allow. Use spaces or commas to separate. Avoid SSLv3, TLSv1.0, TLSv1.1.

syslog_enable.description: Log to syslog instead of file-based logs.

tcp_wrappers.description: Use TCP Wrappers (/etc/hosts.allow, /etc/hosts.deny) for access control.

timeout.description: Idle session timeout in seconds (0 = no timeout).

user_config_dir.description: Directory containing per-user config files (named by username).

user_sub_token.description: Token used to substitute virtual usernames in paths (e.g., /home/vsftpd/$USER).

utf8_filesystem.description: Assume filesystem uses UTF-8 encoding (helps with international filenames).

virtual_user_config_dir.description: Directory for per-virtual-user config files (used when guest_enable=YES).

write_enable.description: Allow FTP write operations (uploads, deletes, renames). Disable for read-only FTP.

xferlog_file.description: Path to the transfer log file.

xferlog_std_format.description: Use standard wu-ftpd-style log format (for compatibility with log analyzers).

dumpdir.description: Store resulting files to specified directory.

enabled.description: Enable backup fleecing.

ionice.description: Set IO priority when using the BFQ scheduler.

keep-all.description: Keep all backups. Conflicts with other options when true.

keep-daily.description: Keep backups for the last N different days.

keep-hourly.description: Keep backups for the last N different hours.

keep-monthly.description: Keep backups for the last N different months.

keep-weekly.description: Keep backups for the last N different weeks.

keep-yearly.description: Keep backups for the last N different years.

lockwait.description: Maximal time to wait for the global lock (minutes).

mailnotification.description: Deprecated: use notification targets/matchers instead. Specify when to send a notification mail.

mailto.description: Deprecated: Use notification targets/matchers instead. Comma-separated list of email addresses or users that should receive email notifications.

max-workers.description: Allow up to this many IO workers at the same time for VMs.

notes-template.description: Template string for generating notes for the backup(s).

notification-mode.description: Determine which notification system to use.

pbs-change-detection-mode.description: PBS mode used to detect file changes and switch encoding format for container backups.

pbs-entries-max.description: Limits number of entries allowed in memory for container backups to PBS.

pigz.description: Use pigz instead of gzip when N>0.

pool.description: Backup all known guest systems included in the specified pool.

protected.description: If true, mark backup(s) as protected.

prune-backups.description: Use these retention options instead of those from the storage configuration.

remove.description: Prune older backups according to prune-backups.

stopwait.description: Maximal time to wait until a guest system is stopped (minutes).

storage.description: Store resulting file to this storage.

tmpdir.description: Store temporary files to specified directory.

AccelerationThreshold.description: sets velocity threshold for acceleration to take effect

AdaptiveDeceleration.description: allows deceleration at low pointer speeds

AllowByteSwappedClients.description: allows clients with different byte-order than the server

AllowMouseOpenFail.description: tells mousedrv/vmmouse not to report failure if mouse can't be opened

AllowNonLocalXvidtune.description: allows xvidtune to connect from another host

AutoAddDevices.description: enables automatic input device addition from HAL/udev

AutoAddGPU.description: enables automatic GPU device addition from udev

AutoBindGPU.description: enables automatic secondary GPU setup as output-sources

AutoEnableDevices.description: enables automatic device enabling after adding

AutoServerLayout.description: always adds the device to the ServerLayout section

BlankTime.description: sets inactivity timeout for blank phase of screensaver (minutes)

BusID.description: specifies the bus location of the graphics card

Chipset.description: specifies the chipset used on the graphics board

Clocks.description: specifies pixel clocks supported by the graphics board

ConstantDeceleration.description: multiplies pointer speed by a constant factor

DisableVidModeExtension.description: disables VidMode extension parts used by xvidtune

DisplaySize.description: specifies physical width/height of monitor in mm

DontVTSwitch.description: disallows Ctrl+Alt+Fn sequence for virtual terminal switching

DontZap.description: disallows Ctrl+Alt+Backspace to terminate X server

Floating.description: sets up device floating (no event reporting via master device)

FontPath.description: sets the search path for fonts

GlxVisuals.description: controls how many GLX visuals are set up

HTimings.description: horizontal timings for a video mode

IgnoreABI.description: allows modules built for a different X server version to load

IndirectGLX.description: enables or disables indirect GLX contexts

Load.description: loads a specified Xorg server module

MatchDriver.description: matches kernel driver name for outputs

MatchProduct.description: matches substring in device's product name

MatchSeat.description: matches seat ID from -seat server option

MatchVendor.description: matches substring in device's vendor name

MaxClients.description: sets maximum number of clients allowed to connect

MemBase.description: specifies linear frame buffer base address

ModeLine.description: compact definition for a video mode

ModulePath.description: sets the search path for loadable Xorg server modules

NoMatchProduct.description: negative match for product name substring

NoMatchTag.description: negative match for config backend tags

NoMatchVendor.description: negative match for vendor name substring

NoOutputInitialSize.description: overrides screen size when no outputs are connected

OffTime.description: sets inactivity timeout for DPMS off phase (minutes)

Position.description: specifies position of monitor (x y coordinates)

PreferCloneMode.description: prefers clone mode for monitors over horizontal extend

PreferredMode.description: specifies preferred initial video mode for monitor

Screen.description: specifies which display head this device applies to

StandbyTime.description: sets inactivity timeout for DPMS standby phase (minutes)

SuspendTime.description: sets inactivity timeout for DPMS suspend phase (minutes)

SyncOnGreen.description: drives sync signal on green color pin

TransformationMatrix.description: 3x3 transformation matrix for absolute input devices

UseDefaultFontPath.description: includes default font path even if other paths are specified

UseModes.description: includes video modes from named Modes section

VScan.description: number of times each scanline is painted

VTimings.description: vertical timings for a video mode

VideoRam.description: specifies video RAM size in kBytes

XkbDir.description: sets the base directory for keyboard layout files

ZoomModes.description: specifies modes for zoom switching via keypad

EnableProcessId.description: Includes process ID in log messages.

able_token_login.description: Requires username and password during initial connection.

background.description: Hex RGB background color for login/log window.

black.description: Hex RGB color for black (login/log window).

bulk_compression.description: Enables compression of bulk data in xrdp(8).

channel_code.description: Disables all channels if set to false.

chansrvport.description: xrdp-chansrv display or domain socket path.

cliprdr.description: Enables RDP channel for clipboard redirection.

crypt_level.description: Regulates encryption level of Standard RDP Security.

dark_blue.description: Hex RGB color for dark blue.

dark_grey.description: Hex RGB color for dark grey.

disabled_encodings_mask.description: Bitmask to disable Xvnc server encodings.

fork.description: Forks a subprocess for each connection if enabled.

hidelogwindow.description: Hides the log messages window if enabled.

ip.description: IP address of host to connect to.

key_file.description: Path to TLS private key file.

max_bpp.description: Maximum color depth (bits per pixel) allowed.

name.description: Display name of connection in login window.

omain_user_separator.description: Separator to append domain name to username.

pamerrortxt.description: Error text passed to PAM on authentication failure.

password.description: Password for connection (supports ask/base64).

port.description: Port to connect to (-1 for default).

rail.description: Enables RDP channel for remote applications (RAIL).

rdpdr.description: Enables RDP channel for device redirection.

require_credentials.description: Treats domain separator in username as autologon.

security_layer.description: Security method: TLS, RDP, or negotiate.

tcp_recv_buffer_bytes.description: Size of TCP receive buffer in bytes.

tcp_send_buffer_bytes.description: Size of TCP send buffer in bytes.

xrdpvr.description: Enables RDP channel for XRDP video streaming.

xserverbpp.description: Color depth of backend X server (bpp).
